sa: निकुम्भस्तु रणे नीलं नीलाञ्जनचयप्रभम्। निर्बिभेद शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः करैर्मेधमिवांशुमान्॥
en: Nikumbha in fight wounded Nila resembling a mass of blue collyrium, with sharpened shafts, as the Sun pierce clouds with his rays.

sa: चतुर्विंशत्सहस्राणि श्लोकानामुक्तवानृषिः। तथा सर्गशतान् पञ्च षट्काण्डानि तथोत्रम्॥
en: The saint recited twenty-four thousand slokas; and it consists of five hundred sections, and is divided into six Kāndas with the Uttara.

sa: शरैरनेकसाहस्रैराच्छिनत् सूतनन्दनः। तस्मिस्तु निहते चक्रे सूतजेन महात्मना।॥
en: Was cut-off by the charioteer's son with many thousands arrows. The car-wheel being thus cut to pieces, Shahadeva then, O worshipful sire.

sa: तृणबिन्दुप्रसादाच्च धर्मस्य च महात्मनः। अज्ञातवासमेवं तु विराटनगरेऽवसन्॥
en: By the grace of the ascetic Trinabindu and of the high-souled Dharma they began to live incognito in the city of Virata.

sa: परिवार्य ततो भीमं जेतुकामो जयद्रथः। रथैरनेकसाहौर्भीमस्यावारयद् दिशः॥
en: Thereafter king Jayadratha, desirous of slaying Bhima, surrounded him on all sides with thousands of chariots, and warriors, and thus intercepted him.

sa: पञ्चालाः केकया मत्स्या चेदिकारूषकोसलाः। युधिष्ठिरमभीप्सन्तो दृष्ट्वा द्रोणमुपाद्रवन्॥
en: The Panchalas, the Kckayas, the Matsyas, the Chedikas, the Karuasas and the Koshalas, desirous of rescuing Yudhishthira, rushed at Drona with delight.

sa: यत्रेष्टं वासुदेवेन सत्रैर्वर्षगणान् बहून्। श्रद्दधानेन सततं धर्मसम्प्रतिपत्तये॥
en: Here for the establishment of virtue and religion Vasudeva with with pious devotion performed his sacrifices with extended for many long years.

sa: यच्चापि वज्रपाणेस्तु प्रियं कृतमरिंदम। एतदाख्याहि मे सर्वमखिलेनधनंजय॥
en: What good (service) you rendered to the wielder of the thunderbolt-the tormentor of foes, O Dhananjaya, relate to me (all) this fully"

sa: दुरासदं दुष्प्रसह सुरदानवराक्षसैः। अनुज्ञातस्त्वहं तेन तत्रैव समुपाविशम्॥
en: Unrivalled and difficult to be endured by the gods, the Danavas and the Rakshasas. Commanded by him, I then sat down there,

sa: तेन दुर्वारितास्त्रेण निमित्तचपलेषुणा। महान् वनतरुस्तत्र विद्धो मृगजिघांसया॥
en: The arrow of that fowler of irresistible arms, shot for the destruction of the antelope, missing its aim, pierced a powerful foresttree.

sa: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं शरैर्बहुभिराचिनोत्। निर्भिन्नश्च शरैस्तेन द्विषता क्षिप्रकारिणा॥
en: Then he pierced the king whose bow had been severed, with numerous shafts. Thereat mangled with the arrows of his light-handed enemy.

sa: तेषां पदातिनागानां पादरक्षा सहस्रशः। पट्टिशासिधराः शूरा बभूवुरनिवर्तिनः॥
en: The rear of that elephant army was protected by thousands of horses with swords and Patticas never to return back from battle.

sa: शूलमुद्गरधारिण्या शैलपादपहस्तया॥ रक्षसां घोररूपाणां महत्या सेनया वृतः।
en: Instantly he was encircled by a numerous force of dreadful looking Rakshasas armed with lances and large rocks and stones and clubs.

sa: ततोऽन्तरिक्षमुत्पत्य कालमेघ इवोन्नदन्॥ प्रववर्ष महाकायो दुमवर्ष नभस्तलात्।
en: Then soaring into the sky and roaring like destructive clouds, the huge-bodied Rakshasa poured a veritable shower of trees from the skies.

sa: कालसंचोदिता जीवा मज्जन्ति नरकेऽवशाः। परितुष्टानि सर्वाणि दिव्यान्याहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: Urged by Times creatures sink helplessly in hell. Some again, the sages hold, go to heaven. All these pass their time happily.

sa: तासां तीरेष्वासते पुण्यभाजो महीयमानाः पृथगप्सरोभिः। हिरण्यवर्णाभिरतीव हृष्टाः॥
en: Pious men, specially adored by the Apsaras, who are viriuous, well-adorned and goldencomplexioned, live in contentment on the banks of these lakes,

sa: तौ परस्परमासाद्य यत्तावन्योन्यरक्षणे। मार्जाराविव भक्षार्ये ततक्षाते मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: Both bent upon carefully protecting themselves, they approached, they repeatedly wounded each other like two cats, fighting for a piece of meat.

sa: महार्हे शयने वीरं स्पास्तरणसंवृते। शयानमतिविश्वस्तं ब्रह्मण्यं सत्यवादिनम्॥
en: And when that truthful hero, devoted to the Brahmanas, was comfortably lying down on a costly bed furnished with a rich sheet.

sa: अग्निकार्यं च कर्तव्यं परमान्नेन भोजनम्। दीपकश्चापि कर्तव्यः पितॄणां सतिलोदकः॥ एतेन विधिना मर्त्यः श्रद्दधानः समाहितः। चतुरो वार्षिकान् मासान् यो ददाति तिलोदकम्॥ भोजनं च यथाशक्त्या ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे। पशुबधशतस्येह फलं प्राप्नोति पुष्कलम्॥
en: That man who offers for the four months of the rainy season sesame and water (to the Pitris) and food, according to the best of his power to a Brahmana thoroughly expert in duties, who duly pours libations on the sacred fire, and makes offerings of rice boiled in sugared milk, who gives lamps in honor of the ancestors, with sesame and water, indeed he who does all this with faith and rapt attention, acquires all the merits of a hundred sacrifices in which animals are offered up to the celestials.

sa: खद्योतवदभिज्ञातं तन्मया विद्धधमन्तिकात्। एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वल्मीकं शर्यातिस्तूर्णमभ्ययात्॥
en: Believing it to be a fire fly, I pierced it with the thorn." Having heard this, Sharyati immediately went to the ant-hill.

sa: बुद्धेर्थेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं शृणु। प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनंजयः॥
en: Listen to three fold division of intellect and constancy. O Dhananjaya, I shall exhaustively and distinctly speak to you on this matter.

sa: ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परंतप। कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः॥
en: O chastiser of foes, the duties of Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, and Shudras are each distinguished by these three qualities, born of nature.

sa: तलैश्चैवाथ निस्त्रिंशैर्बाहुभिश्च सुसंस्थितैः। विवरं प्राप्य चान्योन्यमनयन् यमसादनम्॥
en: Their sabers and palms and sinewy arms. Availing themselves of another's one weaknesses, they dispatched one another to the regions of Death.

sa: तत: संनोदयामास हयानाशु त्रिहायनान्॥ नातिहष्टमनाः सूतो हेमभाण्डपरिच्छदान्॥
en: Then the charioteer with a heart scarcely cheerful, urged on his steeds, three years of age and decked with caparisons of gold.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनं शितैर्बाणैर्दशभिर्दशभिः पुनः। प्राविध्यन्त ततः पार्थस्तानविध्यत् स्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः॥
en: Thereat they pierced Arjuna with ten whetted shafts separately; and the son of Pritha also pierced them separately with three shafts each.

sa: चरन्तस्त्वसिमाश्चि शिक्षया। संग्राममनसः शूरा दृश्यन्ते सम सहस्रशः॥
en: Thousands of heroic warriors longing for battle, were seen to perform various evolutions of swordsmen and bowmen, with dexterity acquired through discipline.

sa: रथिनः सादिनः सर्वे सिंहनादमथानदन्। बिभित्सवस्ततो व्यूहं निर्ययुयुद्धकाक्षिणः॥
en: The car-warriors and cavalry soldiers uttered their war-cries (resembling leonine roars). Then, desirous of battle fierce warriors began to leave their ranks.

sa: शेषाः प्रतियुर्यत्ता भीष्ममेव महारथम्। ततो राजसमूहास्ते परिवQर्धनंजयम्॥
en: The rest putting forth all their endeavors advanced against the mighty car-warrior Bhima. Thereafter thousand of monarchs surrounded Dhananjaya on all sides.

sa: दीर्घायुषो महाराज जरामृत्युविवर्जिताः॥ प्रजास्तत्र विवर्धन्ते वर्षास्विव समुद्रगाः।
en: O king, being free from old age and death, and possessing long life, the people there grow like rivers in the rains.

sa: सर्वेषां राजपुत्राणामभिमन्युरसंशयम्। कर्मणाः तोषयिष्यामि भूयश्चैव वचः शृणु॥
en: And Abhimanyu is without doubt the death of all the princes. I shall satisfy you by my deeds. Hear again my words.

sa: अश्वत्थामा कृपश्चैव शीर्षमास्तां यशस्विनौ। त्रैगर्तेरथ कैकेयैर्वाटधानैश्च संयुगे॥
en: Those two illustrious heroes, Ashvathama and Kripa, backed by the Trigartas, the Matsyas, the Kaikeyas and the Vatadhanas stood at its head.

sa: तौ मण्डलानि चित्राणि रथाभ्यां सव्यदक्षिणम्। चरमाणावयुध्येतां रथशिक्षाविशारदौ॥
en: Then those two heroes well-versed in the art of driving cars, fought on describing beautiful circles, right and left, with their ears.

sa: तमहं समवष्टभ्य पुनरात्मानमाहवे। शतसंख्यैः शरैः क्रुद्धस्तदा राममवाकिरम्॥
en: Then did I, with wrath, shoot on Rama arrows, hundred in number after summoning all my patience and addressing myself to battle.

sa: तत्सिन्धुपतिना राज्ञा पालितं ध्वजिनीमुखम्। अनन्तरथनागाश्वमशोभत महद् बलम्॥
en: That large army with innumerable cars and elephants and horse under the command of the kings of the Sindhus looked very grant.

sa: केशवेन हते संख्ये पितर्यथ नराधिपे। भिन्ने कपाटे पाण्ड्यानां विद्रुतेषु च बन्धुषु॥ भीष्मादवाप्य चास्त्राणि दोणाद् रामात् कृपात् तथा। अस्त्रैः समत्वं सम्प्राप्य रुक्मिकर्णार्जुनाच्युतैः॥ इयेष द्वारकां हन्तुं कृत्स्नां जेतुं च मेदिनीम्। निवारितस्ततः प्राज्ञैः सुद्भिर्हितकाम्यया॥ वैरानुबन्धमुत्सृज्य स्वराज्यमनुशास्ति यः। स सागरध्वजः पाण्ड्यश्चन्द्ररश्मिनिभैर्हयैः॥ वैडूर्यजालसंछन्नैर्वीर्यद्रविणमाश्रितः। दिव्यं विस्फारयंश्चापं द्रोणमभ्यद्रवद् बली॥
en: The heroic Sarangadvaja endowed with the wealth of energy, the ruler of the Pandyas, mounted on chargers of the colour of the moon-beams and clad in coats of mail set with lapises, rushed at Drona stretching his bow of superior make. His dominions having been on invaded and his relatives having escaped, his sire had been slain, O monarch, in battle by Krishna; securing weapons then from Bhishma, Drona and Rama and Kripa, he became, in the use of weapons, equal to Rukmi, Karna, Arjuna and Achyuta. He then became intent on destroying the city of Dvaraka and subjugating the whole world. But his wise friends out of a desire to do good to him. prevented him from that course. Abandoning all thoughts of revenge, he is now ruling his own dominions.

sa: संदधे परवीरघ्नः कालाग्न्यनिलवर्चसम्। तस्योरस्तूर्णमासाद्य जत्रुदेशे विभिद्य तम्॥
en: Flying towards Dushasana's breast, that arrow pierced his shoulder-joint up to the very bones, like a snake piercing into an ant hill.

sa: सरथा रथिनश्चापि विमृद्वन्तः समन्ततः। स्यन्दनादपतत् कश्चिन्निहतोऽन्येन सायकैः॥
en: Car-warriors, with their cars, were crushed (by the elephants). Some warrior fell on their cars killed by other warriors with their arrows.

sa: तत एनं परिष्वज्य शनैराश्वासयंस्तदा। पाणिभिर्जलशीतैश्च जयाशीभिच कौरव॥
en: By embracing him and slowly passing over the palms of their hands rendered cold by water and by blessings of victory, OKaurava.

sa: तस्य चानुचरांस्तीक्ष्णैर्विव्याध परमेषुभिः॥ अवज्ञापूर्वकं शूरः सौभद्रस्य रणाजिरे।
en: Then as if in contempt, the valiant Karna pierced the followers of Subhadra's son in battle with sharp shafts of excellent make.

sa: संजय उवाच महाप्रभावे वरदे निपातिते लोकेश्वरे शास्तरि चामितौजसि। पराजितेषु भरतेषु दुर्मनाः कर्णो भृशंन्यश्वसदश्रु वर्तयन्॥
en: Sanjaya said When that giver of boons, that most puicsant hero, that lord of men, that one of great vigour had been slain, that when the Bharatas had been vanquished, Karna, with a sorrowful heart and shedding copious tears, began to comfort (the Kurus).

sa: यमदण्डोपमान् घोराज्वलिताशीविषोपमान्। सौभद्रः समरे क्रुद्धः प्रेषयामास सायकान्॥
en: Inflamed with rage, Subhadra's discharged in that battle fierce arrows that resembled the mace of Death, and blazing snakes of Virulent venom.

sa: उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युदाहृतः। यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः॥
en: But there is another, namely the Supreme Being, called Paramatma, who being the everlasting Lord, and pervading the three worlds, sustains them.

sa: यदि विशति रसातलं तदग्यं वियदपि देवपुरं दितेः पुरं वा। तदपि शरशतैरहं प्रभाते भृशमभिमन्युरिपोः शिरोऽभिहर्ता॥
en: If he enters the nether regions or ascends to the skies or repairs to the celestial regions or to the dominion of the Daityas, I will still, with a group of hundred, shafts, cut-off the head of Abhimanyu's enemy, when this night passed away."

sa: नानाजनौघं युधि सम्प्रवृद्धं गाङ्गं यथा वेगपारणीयम्। मां च स्थितं नागबलस्य मध्ये युयुत्ससे मन्द किमल्पबुद्धे॥
en: Why do you wish to fight, О fool of little understanding, with me in the midst of this army of elephants, this army composed of various races and which in battle is as incapable of being crossed over as the waves of the Ganga.

sa: संजय उवाच तथैव पर्वता राजन् सप्तात्र मणिभूषिताः॥ रत्नाकरास्तथा नद्यस्तेषां नामानि मे शृणु। अतीव गुणवत् सर्वं तत्र पुण्यं जनाधिप॥ देवर्षिगन्धर्वयुतः प्रथमो मेरुरुच्यते।
en: O king there are seven mountains in that island. They are decked with jewels and there are mines of gems and precious stones. There are many rivers in that island. Hear, as I tell you their names. O king, every thing there is charming and delightful. The first of those mountains is called Meru. It is the abode of the celestials, the Rishis and the Gandharvas.

sa: ज्वलितं शूलमुद्यम्य रूपं कृत्वा विभीषणम्। नानारूपप्रहरणैर्वृतो राक्षसपुङ्गवैः॥
en: Balancing his resplendent trident and assuming dreadful appearance, and surrounded by foremost of Rakshasas of fearful main and armed with diverse weapons,

sa: शुशुभाते नरव्याघ्रौ तौ भीष्मशरविक्षतौ। गोवृषाविव संरब्धौ विषाणैरिखितङ्कितौ॥
en: Wounded by those arrows of Bhishma those foremost of men looked like two roaring bulls with scratches of horns on their bodies.

sa: ध्वजा बहुविधाकारास्तावकानां नराधिप। काञ्चनाङ्गदिनो रेजुर्खलिता इव पावकाः॥
en: O king, the standards of various forms belonging to the warriors on your side, adorned with golden rings, looked like blazing fire.

sa: सप्रजः सनृपामात्यः सदारापत्यबान्धवः॥ यौवनेन सहस्राब्दं मरुत्तो राज्यमन्वशात्।
en: With his children, counsellors wives, descendants, relatives, king Marutta, in the days of his youth, ruled his dominions for a thousand years.

sa: तालेन महता भीष्मः पञ्चतारेण केतुना। विमलादित्यसंकाशस्तस्थौ कुरुचमुपरि॥
en: With his large palmyra standard with five stars, Bhishma, the Generalissimo of the Kuru army, looked as resplendent as the sun himself.

sa: श्रुत्वा शङ्खस्य निर्घोषं पाण्डवस्य महौजसः। त्वदीयेष्वप्यनीकेषु वादित्राण्यभिजजिरे॥
en: Hearing that blare of the conchs sounded by the highly-puissant sons of Pandu, your soldiers in their camp struck up various instruments.

sa: कवचोपहितैर्गात्रैर्हस्तैश्च समलंकृतैः। मुखैश्च चन्द्रसंकाशै रक्तान्तनयनैः शुभैः॥ गजवाजिमनुष्याणां सर्वगात्रैश्च भूपते। आसीत् सर्वा समास्तीर्णा मुहूर्तेन वसुंधरा॥
en: In A moment the earth literally became covered over with bodies cased in arinours, with decorated arms, with faces charming like the moon and beauty fled with eyes with coppery corners, and O monarch, with the of dead bodies of elephants, steeds and men.

sa: तमुदीर्यन्तमालोक्य राजा दुर्योधनस्ततः। स्थानामयुतं तस्य प्रेषयामास भारत।।५।
en: The king Duryodhana beholding him swell like a raging fire, O Bharata dispatched against him a division consisting of ten thousand cars.

sa: भूतान्युपनिविष्टानि गतिमन्ति ध्रुवाणि च॥ तेषामृद्धिर्बहुविधा दृश्यते दैवमानुषी।
en: Various mobile and immobile creatures are all placed in them. Various sorts of prosperity, both providential and human are noticeable in them.

sa: नेच्छतः। एकात्मानौ द्विधाभूतौ दृश्येते मानवैर्भुवि। मनसाऽपि हि दुर्धर्षी सेनामेतां यशस्विनौ॥ नाशयेतामिहेच्छन्तौ मानुषत्वाच्च युगस्येव विपर्यासो लोकानामिव मोहनम्॥ भीष्मस्य च वधस्तात द्रोणस्य च महात्मनः। न होव ब्रह्मचर्येण न वेदाध्ययनेन च॥
en: On earth they appear to men as two different persons, though ir reality they are of one and the same soul. That highly-renowned invincible pair, can with the fiat of their will slay this host, if only they wish it. But for humanity's sake, they do not wish it. O son, the slaughter of Bhishma and Drona, of high souls, appears to be like the over-turning of the Yuga and the stupefaction of the senses. In this world neither by Brahmacharya, nor by the study of the Vedas.

sa: पञ्चविंशतिसाहस्रान् निजघान महारथान्॥ ते हि दुर्योधनादिष्टास्तदा पार्थनिबर्हणे।
en: Slew twenty five thousand mighty carwarrior of the hostile host. These warriors, being commanded by Duryodhana to slay the son of Pritha,

sa: सक्ताः कर्मण्यविद्वांसो यथा कुर्वन्ति भारत। कुर्याद् विद्वांस्तथासऽक्तश्चिकीर्षुर्लोकसंग्रहम्॥
en: Ignorant men act with attachment to actions, but the learned act without attachment to actions. Desiring to stick men to their duties.

sa: ताड्यमानाः क्षितिं जग्मुर्मुक्तकेशाः शरार्दिताः। केचिदार्तस्वनं चक्रुर्विनेशुरपरे पुनः॥
en: Some uttered distressful cries, some emitted loud roars; others again struck by the shafts of Pritha's son, fell down deprived of life.

sa: विमुक्तां बहुभिर्योधैः शस्त्रवृष्टिं दुरासदाम्। यदेको वारयामास मारुतोऽभ्रगणानिव॥
en: In as much as, single-handed, he baffled the indefeasible shower of arrows poured by many, like the wind scattering masses of clouds.

sa: रक्ष्यमाणश्च तैविप्रैर्नाहं भूमिमुपास्पृशम्। अन्तरिक्षे धृतो ह्यस्मि तैर्विप्रैर्बान्धवैरिव॥
en: Being supported by the twice-born, I did not touch the ground and was held in the air by them as by friends.

sa: द्रवतस्तान् समालक्ष्य भीष्मद्रोणौ महारथौ। न्यवारयेतां संरब्यौ दुर्योधनहितैषिणौ॥
en: Seeing the army flying, the mighty Bhishma and Drona both enraged and both eager to do Duryodhana's good tried to stop them.

sa: पतितान् विविधांश्चापाश्चित्रान् हेमपरिष्कृतान्। कुथा बहुविधाकाराश्चामरान् व्यजनानि च॥
en: And diverse-sharped, capricious for elephants, and chamaras and fans and numerous bows variegated and decorated with gold, lay scattered on the field.

sa: नानावर्णेन रूपेण नानाकृतिमुखा हयाः। रथचक्रध्वजं वीरं घटोत्कचमुदावहन्॥
en: Charges of various hues and appearance and stature and face, born the heroic Ghatotkacha, the device on whose banner was a car-wheel.

sa: अथोत्तरे महेष्वासाः सहसैन्या नराधिपाः। व्यूहं तं पूरयामासुयूंहशास्त्रविशारदाः॥
en: Other mighty bowmen, all rulers of earth, and versed in the are of forming arrays with their troop filled up that array.

sa: चतुर्भिरथ नाराचैरावन्त्यस्य महात्मनः। जघान चतुरो वाहान् क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः॥
en: Then again with eyes red in rage, the Rakshasa slew with four lances the four steeds of the high-souled princes of Avanti.

sa: सुतास्तव महाराज त्रिंशत्रिदशसंनिभाः। गान्धारराजः कितवः शल्यो भूरिश्रवास्तथा॥
en: Stood, O mighty monarch, your thirty sons, all resembling the celestials themselves. That gamester, the ruler of the Gandharas, Shalya and Bhurishravas.

sa: सादिनो ध्वजिनश्चैव हताः प्रवरवाजिनः। विप्रद्रुतस्थानीकाः समपद्यन्त पाण्डवाः॥
en: Many horsemen and car warriors and best of horses fell in quick succession. Many carwarriors of the Pandava began to run away.

sa: तेऽभिजाता महेष्वासाः सुवर्णविकृतध्वजाः। परीष्सन्तोऽभ्यधावन्त धृष्टद्युम्नवृकोदरौ॥ तौ च दृष्ट्वा महेष्वासावभिमन्युपुरोगमान्। बभूवतुर्मुदा युक्तौ निघ्नन्तौ तव वाहिनीम्॥
en: Desirous of rescuing Dhrishtadyumna and Vrikodara, those fierce bowmen owning and standards decked with gold, approached the former breaking through the hostile ranks. Those two heroes viz., Vrikodara and Dhrishtadyumna himself, became filled with delight, and fell (with increase ardour) to slaughter your troops.

sa: हयानामुत्तमाङ्गैश्च हस्तिहस्तैश्च मेदिनी। बाहुभिश्च शिरोभिश्च वीराणां समकीर्यत॥
en: The Earth became strewn over with the heads of horses, the trunks of elephants and the heads and arms of heroic warriors.

sa: सुतास्तव महाराज त्रिंशत्रिदशसंनिभाः। गान्धारराजः कितवः शल्यो भूरिश्रवास्तथा॥
en: Stood, O mighty monarch, your thirty sons, all resembling the celestials themselves. That gamester, the ruler of the Gandharas, Shalya and Bhurishravas.

sa: तं द्रौणिः पञ्चविंशत्या क्षुद्रकाणां समार्पयत्। वरं वरममित्राणामारुजन्तमभीतवत्॥
en: Then Drona's son dauntlessly struck Abhimanyu with twenty-five short arrows, when the latter was occupied in slaying the best among his enemies.

sa: कथं न ज्ञेयमस्माभिः पापादस्मानिवर्तितुम्। कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं प्रपश्यद्भिर्जनार्दन॥
en: Why should we not, O Janardana who know that sin is the result of exterminating the race, learn to desist from it?

sa: रथिभिर्वारणैरश्वैः पादातैश्च समीरितम्। घोरमायोधनं चक्रे महाभ्रसदृशं रजः॥
en: A thick clouds of dust, raised by carwarriors, elephants, steeds and foot soldiers, made the battle that raged all the more terrible.

sa: अथैनं रथवृन्देन कोष्ठकीकृत्य भारत। शरैः सुबहुसाहः समन्तादभ्यवारयन्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, having surrounded him with many thousand cars, they covered him from all sides with many hundreds of arrows.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कधं सदोपवासी स्याद् ब्रह्मचारी कथं भवेत्। विघसाशी कथं च स्यात् सदा चैवातिथिव्रतः॥
en: Yudhishthira said one ever How can one practising such penance come to be known as one who is always fasting or as who follows the VOW of Brahmacharya, or as one who always lives upon sacrificial residue, or as one who always worships guests.

sa: युगं द्वादशसाहस्रं कल्पं विद्धि चतुर्युगम्। दशकल्पशतावृत्तमहस्तद् ब्राह्ममुच्यते॥
en: Twelve thousand years make a cycle. Four such cycles, taken a thousand times, make a Kalpa which measures one day of Brahman.

sa: पुरोहित उवाच पुण्याहवाचने नित्यं धर्मकृत्येषु चासकृत्। शान्तिहोमेषु च सदा किं त्वं हससि वीक्ष्य माम्॥५०
en: The priest said Every day, on occasions of receiving benedictions from me, when, again, I am engaged in the performance of religious rites, on your behalf, on occasions also of the Homa and other rites of propitiation, why do you laugh upon seeing me?

sa: एवमेव च क्षेत्रज्ञः क्षेत्रज्ञानपरिक्षये। प्रकृत्या निर्गुणस्त्वेष इत्येवमनुशुश्रुम॥
en: Thus it is that Soul, when his knowledge of Soil disappears, becomes, by his nature, shorn of qualities. We have heard it.

sa: ततस्तस्मिन् महाघोरे संध्याकाल उपस्थिते। राजानः समसज्जन्त समासाद्येतरेतरम्॥
en: When the terrible period of the junction of Treta and the Dvapara, set in the Kshatriyas, approaching one another, began to fight.

sa: स एष चरते वायुरर्णवोत्पीडसम्भवः। आकाशस्थानमासाद्य प्रशान्ति नाधिगच्छति॥
en: Generated by the pressure of the ocean of water, that wind still passes on. Occupying empty space, its motion is never stoppcd.

sa: पञ्चात्मके पञ्चगुणप्रदर्शी स सर्वगात्रानुगतोऽन्तरात्मा। स वेत्ति दुःखानि सुखानि चात्र तद्विप्रयोगात् तु न वेत्ति देहः॥
en: Permeating all the limbs, that Soul witness the acts of the mind possessing five attributes and living within the body composed of the five elements. It is he who feels pleasure and pain, and when separated from him the body does not feel them.

sa: तावपि ख्याततपसौ नरनारायणावृषी॥ तस्मिन्नेवाश्रमे रम्ये तेपतुस्तप उत्तमम्।
en: Those foremost of ascetics, viz., Nara and Narayana, however, continued to live in their charming hermitage of Vadari, practising the severest austerities.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच कथान्तरमथासाद्य खड्गयुद्धविशारदः। नकुलः शरतल्पस्थमिदमाह पितामहम्॥
en: When this discourse was finished, Nakula who was an expert swordsman thus questioned the Kuru grandfather lying on his bed of arrows.

sa: वर्धयामास तेजश्च किमर्थममितौजसाम्। नित्यं वैरनिबद्धाश्च दानवाः सुरसत्तमैः॥
en: Why was he engaged in diminishing the energy of the gods? Why the Danavas always fought with the foremost of the gods.

sa: अभिवाद्य गुरुं ब्रूयादधीष्व भगवन्निति। करिष्ये भगवन्निदं चापि कृतं मया।॥ ब्रह्मस्तदपि कर्तास्मि यद् भवान् वक्ष्यतेपुनः।
en: Reverentially saluting the preceptor, he should say to him:-O illustrious one, teach me! I shall do this, O illustrious one! This ] have already done, O twice born one. I am ready to do whatever else your reverend self may be pleased to command.

sa: सहस्रशोऽप्यनेकशः प्रवक्तुमुत्सहाम ते। अबुद्धिमोहनं पुनः प्रभुर्निनाय पावकः॥
en: I can give you thousands and thousands of instructions. Know, however, that the powerful cleanser keeps all foolish persons in the Dark.

sa: नारद उवाच नमस्ते देवदेवेश २ निष्क्रिय ३ निर्गुण ४ लोकसाक्षिन् ५ क्षेत्रज्ञ ६ पुरुषोत्तम ७ अनन्त ८ पुरुष ९ महापुरुष १० पुरुषोत्तम ११ त्रिगुण १२ प्रधान १३ अमृत १४ अमृताख्य १५ अनन्ताख्य १६ व्योम १७ सनातन १८ सदसव्यक्ताव्यक्त १९ ऋतधामन् २० आदिदेव २१ वसुप्रद २२ प्रजापते २३ सुप्रजापते २४ वनस्पते २५ महाप्रजापते २६ ऊर्जस्पते २७ वाचस्पते २८ जगत्पते २९ मनस्पते ३० दिवस्पते ३१ मरुत्पते ३२ सलिलपते ३३ पृथिवीपते ३४ दिक्पते ३५ पुर्वनिवास ३६ गुह्य ३७ ब्रह्मपुरोहित ३८ ब्रह्मकायिक ३९ महाराजिक ४० चातुर्महाराजिक ४१ भ
en: Narada said “Salutation to you, O God of gods, O you that are freed from all acts! You are he who is divested of all attributes, who is the Witness of all the worlds, who is called Soul, who is the foremost of all Beings, who is Infinite, who is called Purusha, who is the great Purusha, who is the foremost of all Purushas, who is the soul of the three attributes, who is called the Foremost, who is Amrita (nectar), who is called Immortal, who is called Ananta (Sesha), who is Space, who is without beginning, who is both Manifest and Unmanifest as existent and not-existent things, who is said to have his home in Truth, who is the first of gods (Narayana), who is the giver of riches, who is at one with Daksha and other Lords of the Creation, who is the Ashvatha and other big trees, who is the

sa: विघसं भृत्यशेषं तु यज्ञशेषमथामृतम्॥ स्वदारनिरतो दान्तो ह्यनसूयुर्जितेन्द्रियः।
en: A householder should be content with his own married wife. He should be selfcontrolled. He should avoid malice and control his senses.

sa: प्रकृत्या क्षेत्रभूतास्ता नराः क्षेत्रज्ञलक्षणाः। तस्मादेवाविशेषेण नरोऽतीयाद् विशेषतः॥
en: By their nature, women are Kshetra, and men are Kshetrajna in respect of qualities. Therefore, wise persons should not pursue women especially.

sa: एवमेते समाम्नाता विश्वेदेवास्तथाश्विनौ। आदित्याः क्षत्रियास्तेषां विशश्च मरुतस्तथा॥
en: Thus have the Vishvas, the gods, and the Ashvins, been enumerated. Amongst them, the Adityas are Kshatriyas, and the Maruts are Vaishyas.

sa: त्रीन् पिण्डान् न्यस्य पृथव्यां पूर्वं दत्त्वा कुशानिति। कथं तु पिण्डसंज्ञां ते पितरो लेभिरे पुरा॥
en: Having first spread some blades of Kusha grass, the gods and the departed manes placed three funeral cakes thereon and thus adored each other. I wish to know, however, the reason why the departed manes in days of yore acquired the name of Pindas.

sa: अब्रुवन् कस्यचिनिन्दामात्मपूजामवर्णयन्। विपश्चिद् गुणसम्पन्नः प्राप्नोत्येव महद् यशः॥
en: One having true wisdom and real merits, wins great fame by abstaining from speaking ill of others and from indulging in self-praise.

sa: आदित्या वसवः साध्या विश्वेदेवास्तथाश्विनौ। विश्वाभिःस्तुतिभिर्देवं विश्वदेवं समस्तुवम्॥
en: The Adityas, the Vasus, the Sadhyas, the Vishvedevas, and the twin Ashvins praised that Lord of the universe, by singing the hymns.

sa: न हृष्यति महत्यर्थे व्यसने च न शोचति। स वै परिमितप्रज्ञः स दान्तो द्विज उच्यते॥
en: That man who never rejoices even at large accessions and never feels sorrow when overtaken by misfortune, is said to be endued with contented wisdom. Such a man is said to he self-controlled. Indeed, such a man is said to be a twice-born man.

sa: एष वै विक्रियापन्नः सृजत्यात्मानमात्मना। अहङ्कारं महातेजाः प्रजापतिमहंकृतम्॥
en: Undergoing changes He creates Himself. Gifted with great energy, He first creates Consciousness and that Great Being called Prajapati endued with Consciousness.

sa: ते सर्वे समतिक्रम्य विप्रमभ्यर्च्य चासकृत्। ऊचुर्वाक्यमसंदिग्धमातिथेयस्य बान्धवाः॥
en: Approaching the Brahmana and offering him due adorations, the kinsmen and relatives of the great Naga said to him these candid words.

sa: सत्त्वस्य रजसश्चैव तमसश्च निबोध तान्। प्रसादो हर्षजा प्रीतिरसंदहो धृतिः स्मृतिः। एतान् सत्त्वगुणान् विद्यादिमान् राजसतामसान्॥
en: Listen now to those consequences that spring from the qualities of Goodness, Darkness and Ignorance. Contentment, the satisfaction that arises from joy, certainty, intelligence, and memory,-these are the results of the quality of Goodness. I shall now describe the consequences of Darkness and Ignorance.

sa: अतिष्ठन्मारुताहारः शतं किल समाः प्रभुः। आराधयन्महादेवं बहुरूपमुमापतिम्॥
en: The powerful Vyasa remained there for a hundred years, living on air alone, engaged in worshipping many formed Mahadeva, the lord ofUma.

sa: तौ प्रदक्षिणसव्यानि मण्डलानि महाबलौ। चेरतुर्मण्डलगतौ समदाविव कुञ्जरौ॥
en: Those two greatly strong (heroes) circled round the arena with faultless clubs and careered right and left in all the proper form.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा हिडिम्बां स हिडिम्बो लोहितेक्षणः। वधायाभिपपातैनान् दन्तैर्दन्तानुपस्पृशन्॥
en: Having addressed Hidimba thus Hidimba with red eyes, his teeth pressing against teeth, ran at her with the intention of killing her.

sa: प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्या-पृथुवक्षा महायशाः। रामः कमलपत्राक्षः पुरोधसमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: After the night had expired the highly illustrious Rāma having a spacious breast and eyes like lotus petals said to the priest.

sa: ते चाबले परिम्लाने पयःपूर्णपयोधरे। निराशे पुत्रलाभाय सहसैवाभ्यगच्छताम्॥
en: The helpless, disappointed and the sad queens also, with their breasts full of milk suddenly came out to get back their child.

sa: तं तथा निश्चितात्मानं स महात्मा महातपाः। ऋषिर्ब्रह्मविदां श्रेष्ठो मैत्रावरुणिरन्त्यधीः॥ वसिष्ठो वारयामास हेतुना येन तच्छृणु।
en: Seeing him resolved in doing this, that high-souled and greatly ascetic Rishi, that best of all men learned in the Vedas, that son of Mitravaruna, that Rishi acquainted with the positive truth, Vasishtha, prevented him (from accomplishing his desire by arguments). Hear them (now).

sa: प्रीतिसंयोगयुक्ताभिरद्भिः प्रह्लादयस्व मे। पुष्पायुधं दुराधर्ष प्रचण्डशरकार्मुकम्॥ त्वदर्शनसमुद्भूतं विध्यन्तं दुस्सहैः शरैः। उपशामय कल्याणि आत्मदानेन भाविनि॥
en: Extinguish that fire by throwing on it the water of your love. O beautiful lady, pacify, by becoming mine, the irrepressible god of love that has appeared here (in my heart) armed with bow and arrows; he pierces me incessantly with his sharp arrows.

sa: बन्धनाद् विप्रमुक्ताश्च राजानो मधुसूदनम्। पूजयामासुरूचुश्च स्तुतिपूर्वमिदं वचः॥
en: The kings, who had been liberated from their confinement, worshipped the slayer of Madhu; and they thus spoke to him eulogistic words.

sa: नानामृगाणामयुतं वध्यमानं महात्मना। यत्र जातो माहासेनस्तं देशमुपचक्रमे॥
en: He slew millions of diverse other animals. In this way being engaged in hunting the king Ila arrived where Kārtikeya was born.

sa: अष्टक उवाच यदावसो नन्दने कामरूपी संवत्सराणामयुतं शतानाम्। किं कारणं कार्तयुगप्रधान हित्वा च त्वं वसुधामन्वपद्यः॥
en: Ashtaka said: O foremost man of the Krita Yuga, you having been able to assume any form at will, passed millions of years in the garden of Nandana. For what reason have you been compelled to leave that happy region and come here today?

sa: मन्मथाग्निपरीतात्मा संदिग्धाक्षरया गिरा। साधु त्वमसितापाङ्गि कामात मत्तकाशिनि॥ भजस्व भजमानं मां प्राणा हि प्रजहन्ति माम्। त्वदर्थं हि विशालाक्षि मामयं निशितैः शरैः॥ कामः कमलगर्भामे प्रतिविध्यन् न शाम्यति। दष्टमेवमनाक्रन्दे भद्रे काममहाहिना॥
en: In accents weak with emotion and his heart burning with the fire of desire, “O black eyed beauty. O excellent lady, be blessed. I am burning with desire; and I, therefore, solicit you. Accept me, my life is ebbing away. O lady of large eyes, O lotus eyed beauty, it is all for (not having obtained) you. The god of love pierces me day and night with his arrows. O blessed lady, I have been bitten by Kama (the god of love) who is like a large snake.

sa: तरुणा दर्शनीयाश्च नानादेशसमागताः। महारथा कृतास्त्राश्च समुपैष्यन्ति भूमिपाः॥
en: Who are young and handsome, who are great car warriors and accomplished in arms, will all be present there from various countries.

sa: स देवराजसदृशो धर्मज्ञः सत्यवागृजुः। दानधर्मतपोयोगाच्छ्रिया परमया युतः॥
en: He was truthful and virtuous like the king of the celestial; and from his liberality, virtues and asceticism he acquired great fortune.

sa: जरासंधोऽपि नृपतिर्यथोक्तं कौशिकेन तत्। वरप्रदानमखिलं प्राप्य राज्यमपालयत्॥
en: As told by Kaushika, the king Jarasandha received the boons and ruled the kingdom after obtaining the (sovereignty of the) whole world.

sa: सौमित्रिस्तु तथेत्युक्त्वा रथमारोप्य मैथिलीम्॥ प्रययौ शीघ्रतुरगं रामस्याज्ञामनुस्मरन्।
en: Saying 'we shall do the same' he made Sītā ascend the car and remembering Rāma's command proceeded, being carried by quickcoursing steeds.

sa: अन्तर्धाय तदाऽऽत्मानं विश्वामित्रोऽपि भारत। तावुभावतिचक्रांम चिर्कीपन्नात्मनः प्रियम्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, being desirous of benefiting himself, Vishvamitra remained there concealed from the sight of both by making himself invisible.

sa: शल्यस्तस्मै प्रतिश्रुत्य जगामोद्दिश्य पाण्डवान्। शान्तिपूर्वं चाकथयधनेन्द्रविजयं नृपः॥
en: Then it narrates how Shalya went to the Pandavas and how he consoled Yudhishthira by recounting the victory of Indra (over Vitra).

sa: तां तथा मोहमापन्नां विदुरः सर्वधर्मवित्। कुन्तीमाश्वासयामास प्रेष्याभिश्चन्दनोदकैः॥
en: The learned in all the precepts of virtue, Vidura, revived the insensible Kunti by sprinkling over (her face) water mixed with sandal-paste.

sa: सर्वकामैः सुपूर्णानि पताकोच्छायवन्ति च। तत्र संजनयामास नानागाराण्यनेकशः॥
en: With many rooms filled with all sorts of luxuries, decorated with hangings of broad cloth and with banners flying from its top.

sa: गुरोहि भीतो विद्यया चोपहूतः शनैर्वाक्यं जठरे व्याजहार।
en: Having said this, he summoned Kacha, but being afraid of his preceptor's safety, he feebly replied from within the stomach of Shukra.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अपश्यमानस्तमृषि तथा चोक्तस्तया च सः। तां दृष्ट्वा च वरारोहां श्रीमती चारुहासिनीम्॥ विभ्राजमानां वपुषा तपसा च दमेन च। रूपयौवनसम्पन्नामित्युवाच महीपतिः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The king, having not seen the Rishi and having been thus addressed by the maiden, saw that she was exceedingly beautiful, she was an exquisite beauty of sweet smiles and a lady of perfect symmetry of shape. She was in the bloom of her youth and beauty; she was adorned with the beauty of faultless features, hard asceticism and sweet humility. The king

sa: गङ्गां चैवानुयास्याम उद्यानवनशोभिताम्। सहिता भ्रातरः सर्वे जलक्रीडामवाप्नुमः॥
en: "Let us all brothers go to the banks of the Gangas, adorned with gardens and wood, there to sport in the water.

sa: समुत्पपात चाकाशं तत उच्चैविहंगमः। सोऽलम्बं तीर्थमासाद्य देववृक्षानुपागमत्॥
en: The great bird then soared high into the sky. Coming to a holy shrine, called Alamba, where there were many celestial trees.

sa: तेषां तु द्रौपदी दृष्ट्वा सर्वेषामितौजसाम्। सम्प्रमथ्येन्द्रियग्रामं प्रादुरासीन्मनोभवः॥
en: When those immeasurably effulgent heroes looked at Draupadi, the god of love invaded their hearts and continued to grind all their senses.

sa: पञ्चभिस्तैर्महेष्वासैरिन्द्रकल्पैः समन्वितम्। शुशुभे तत् पुरश्रेष्ठं नागैर्भोगवती यथा॥
en: Adorned with those excellent and great bow-men, each like an Indra himself, that best of cities looked like Bhogavati with the Nagas.

sa: आश्रमस्थान्महर्षीश्च धर्षयन्तस्ततस्ततः। अब्रह्मण्या वीर्यमदा मत्ता मदबलेन च॥
en: Bereft of virtue and truth, proud of their strength, intoxicated with their insolence, they even insulted the holy Rishis in their hermitages.

sa: अह्नः परिक्षये ब्रह्मस्ततः साऽचिन्तयत्तदा। वासुकेर्भगिनी भीता धर्मलोपान्मनस्विनी॥
en: O Brahmana, as the day was fading away, fearing the loss of (Jaratkaru's virtue, the excellent sister of Vasuki grew very anxious.

sa: ततः पुत्रिणमात्मानं ज्ञात्वा पौरवनन्दनः। भुमन्युं भरतश्रेष्ठ यौवराज्येऽभ्यषेचयत्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, the descendant of Puru, regarding himself as really possessing a son, installed him as his heir-apparent.

sa: ते दृष्ट्वा देवसंकाशं कृतपादाभिवन्दनम्। राघवं सुदुराधर्षमाशीभिः समपूजयन्॥
en: Seeing them, Rāma saluted them touching their feet. And the Brāhmaṇas too, beholding the irrepressible celestial, like Rāghava, welcomed him with blessings.

sa: राजपुत्रास्तथा चान्ये समेत्य भरतर्षभ। अभिजग्मुस्ततो द्रोणमस्त्रार्थे द्विजसत्तमम्॥
en: O best of Bharata race, many other princes also flocked to that best of Brahmanas, Drona, to learn (the science of) arms.

sa: प्रभविष्याव इति यन्महदभ्युद्यतं तपः। युवयोर्हेतुनानेन नामरत्वं विधीयते॥
en: As you have performed these severe penances from the desire of sovereignty alone, I cannot bestow on you the boon of immortality.

sa: यज्ञैस्तपोभिर्नियमैर्दानैश्च विविधैस्तथा। विशिष्यते स्त्रिया भर्तुनित्यं प्रियहिते स्थितिः॥
en: To be ever engaged in serving her husband is a higher duty to a women than sacrifices, asceticism, vows and various charities.

sa: आदाय रोचनां माल्यं मङ्गल्यान्यपराणि च। धारयन्नगदान् मुख्यान् निर्वृतीवेदनानि च। उपतस्थे जरासंधं युयुत्सं वै पुरोहितः॥
en: The priest brought the yellow pigment obtained from the cow, garlands of flowers, and other auspicious articles, and also various excellent medicines for restoring lost consciousness and for alleviating pains. He came (with these articles) to the king Jarasandha who was panting for fight.

sa: स त्वं सुपुष्टमाहारैः स्वशरीरमनुत्तमम्। भक्षयित्वामृतरसं तेन वृत्तिर्भविष्यति॥
en: Thereupon do you now live upon your own dead body fostered by various food. By this you shall keep up your being.

sa: सौतिरुवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा नागेन्द्रः पितामहवचस्तदा। संदिश्य पन्नगान्सर्वान्वासुकिः शापमोहितः॥
en: Sauti said : The king of the snakes, afflicted with the curse, having heard what the Grandsire said, commanded all the snakes,

sa: नक्तं दिनमथैकत्र स्थिते तस्मिञ्जनाधिपे। अथाजगाम विप्रर्षिस्तदा द्वादशमेऽहनि॥
en: The king remained there four days and nights without intermission; and on the twelfth day the Brahmana Rishi (Vasishtha) came to him.

sa: अहं शापे समुत्सृष्टे समश्रौषं वचस्तदा। मातुरुत्संगमारूढो भयात्पन्नगसत्तमाः॥ देवानां पन्नगश्रेष्ठास्तीक्ष्णास्तीक्ष्णा इति प्रभो। पितामहमुपागम्य दुःखार्तानां महायुते॥
en: O best of the snakes, when that curse was uttered, I lay in fear, crouching on my mother's lap. O best of the snakes, O Lord, O snake of great splendour, I heard from that place the sorrowing gods speaking to the Grandsire saying,

sa: तस्य धर्मप्रवृत्तस्य पार्थिवत्वं चिकीर्षतः। सर्वैर्भवद्भिर्विज्ञाय साहाय्यं क्रियतामिति॥
en: That king, ever devoted to virtue, is solicitous to acquire the imperial dignity. Knowing this from me, help him in his attempt."

sa: लोमहर्षणपुत्र उग्रश्रवाः सौतिः पौराणिको नैमिषारण्ये शौनकस्य कुलपतेर्दादशवार्षिक सत्रे॥ सुखासीनानभ्यगच्छद्ब्रह्मर्षीन् संशितव्रतान्। विनयावनतो भूत्वा कदाचित् सूतनन्दनः॥
en: One day when the great sages of hard austerities, who were present at the twelve years' sacrifice of Kulapati Shaunaka, were comfortably sitting in the Naimisharanya, Rishi Lomaharshana's son, Ugrashrava, popularly known as Sauti, well-read in the Puranas, came to them with all humility.

sa: सुदूरमनुजग्मुस्तं पौरजानपदास्तथा। न्यवर्तन्त ततः पश्चादनुज्ञाता नृपेण ह॥
en: The citizens and other people also followed the king for some distance. Then they returned when they were commanded by the king.

sa: महादेवान्तकाभ्यां च कामात्क्रोधाच्च भारत। एकत्वमुपपन्नानां जज्ञे शूरः परंतपः॥ अश्वत्थामा महावीर्यः शत्रुपक्षभयावहः। वीरः कमलपत्राक्षः क्षितावासीन्नराधिप॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, O king, his son, the heroic, surpassingly energetic and lotus-eyed Ashvathama, the terror of all his foes and the great oppressor of all enemies, was born on earth from the united portions of Mahadeva, Yama, Kama and Krodha.

sa: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य रामे धर्मपरे स्थिते। कालस्तापसरूपेण राजद्वारमुपागमत्॥
en: In this wise the virtuous Rāma having spent some time Kāla, assuming the shape of an ascetic, arrived at the palace gate.

sa: सुपर्णसहिताः सर्पाः काननं च मनोरमम्। सागराम्बुपरिक्षिप्तं पक्षिसंघनिनादितम्॥
en: They with Garuda saw the charming woods, washed by the waters of the sea and resounding with the music of the birds.

sa: अश्विनोस्तु तथैवांशौ रूपेणाप्रतिमौ भुवि। नकुलः सहदेवश्च सर्वभूतमनोहरौ॥
en: The most handsome men amongst all men and the matchless beauties on earth, Nakula and Sahadeva were the portions of the Ashvinas.

sa: भरद्वाजादग्निवेश्यः अग्निवेश्याद् गुरुर्मम। साध्विदं मह्यमददद् द्रोणो ब्राह्मणसत्तमः॥
en: From Bharadvaja, it was obtained by Agnivaishya and from Agnivaishya by my preceptor, and that excellent Brahmana Drona gave it to mc.

sa: अनाधृष्टिसुतस्त्वासीद् राजसूयाश्वमेधकृत्। मतिनार इति ख्यातो राजा परमधार्मिकः॥
en: Anadhrishti had a son, named Matinara who became a very virtuous king and greatly famous. He performed both Rajasuya and Ashvamedha sacrifices.

sa: सा संवृतं महाभागैर्देवद्विजमहर्षिभिः। ददर्श देवं ब्रह्माणं लोककर्तारमव्ययम्॥ गन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च दैवकर्मसु निष्ठितः। वन्द्यमानं मुदोपेतैर्ववन्दे चैनमेत्य सा॥
en: She saw the divine Brahma, the creator of the worlds, who is undeteriorating, seated (on his seat), surrounded by the celestials and great and illustrious Rishis and adored by the delighted Gandharvas and Apsaras who are always engaged in the services of the celestials.

sa: नारदेनैवमुक्तस्तु धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। प्राञ्जलिर्धातृभिः सार्धं तैश्च सर्द्विजोत्तमैः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having been thus addressed by Narada, Dharmaraja Yudhishthira with all the excellent Brahmanas (that were present there) joined his hands.

sa: ततोऽन्यवृत्तमात्मानं समवेक्षस्व भारत। राजंस्त्वं ह्यविधेपात्मा दुर्योधनवशे स्थितः॥
en: Follow a different course of life now, O Bharata! You did not control yourself but suffered yourself to be ruled by Duryodhana.

sa: निमन्त्रयीत सान्त्वेन सम्मानेन तितिक्षया। लोकाराधनमित्येतत् कर्तव्यं भूतिमिच्छता॥
en: A king seeking posperity should win over others by sweet words, honours, and gifts. Thus should he take men into his service.

sa: तमभ्ययान्महासेनः सुरशत्रुमुदारधीः। स कार्तिकेयस्य भयात् क्रौञ्चं शरणमीयिवान्॥
en: Highly intelligent, the great generalissimo Skanda rushed against that enemy of the gods. Fearing Kartikeya, he took shelter within the Krauncha mountain.

sa: यस्य बाहुबलं नित्यं धार्तराष्ट्ररुपासितम्॥ उपासितं यथास्माभिर्बलं गाण्डीवधन्वनः।
en: His might of arms was always adored by the Dhritarashtras even as we always worship the might of the wilder of Gandiva.

sa: नावश्यायोऽपि तत्राभूत् कुत एवाभ्रजातयः। नद्यः संक्षिप्ततोयौघाः किंचिदन्तर्गतास्ततः॥
en: Not even could a dew-drop be seen, what to speak of the gathering clouds? The rivers were all reduced into narrow streamlets.

sa: सितासितौ यदुवरौ शुशुभातेऽधिकं तदा। नभोगतौ यथा राजश्चन्द्रसूर्यो दिनक्षये॥ तस्योर्ध्वबाहोः सदृशं रूपमासीन्महात्मनः। बहुधातुविचित्रस्य श्वेतस्येव महागिरेः॥
en: Those two Yadu heroes, the one dark in complexion and the other fair, shone exceedingly beautiful at that moment, like the Sun and the Moon, The great warrior with uplifted arms appeared like the huge mountain of Kailasa variegated with various kinds of metals.

sa: तस्य क्षतजसंदिग्धं जातरूपपरिष्कृतम्। विमुच्य कवचं कृष्ण शरीरमभिवीक्षते॥
en: Taking of her husband's golden armour, O hero, that damsel is now looking on the body of her husband covered with blood.

sa: तथैवायुतशो योधास्तावकाः पाण्डवान् रणे॥ अभ्यवर्तन्त संक्रुद्धा विविधायुधपाणयः।
en: Similarly, thousands of warriors, of your army, armed with various weapons and filled with anger, proceeded against the Pandavas in that battle.

sa: एवमुक्तः पाण्डवेन भगवान् केशवस्तदा। अभिगम्य दुराधर्षं प्रव्याहारयदच्युतः॥
en: Thus addressed by the son of Pandu, the illustrious Keshava of undecaying glory, approaching the unconquerable Bhishma, spoke to him as follows.

sa: पटहाञ्झर्झरांश्चैव क्रकचान् गोविषाणकान्। आडम्बरान् गोमुखांश्च डिण्डिमांश्च महास्वनान्॥
en: And they also played on their Patahas and Jharjharas and Krikachas and cow-horns and Adambaras and Gomukhas and Dindimas of loud sound.

sa: अन्योन्यकृतवैराणां न संधिरुपपद्यते। स च हेतुरतिक्रान्तो यदर्थमहमावसम्॥
en: Real peace cannot live amongst persons who have injured one another. No such necessity exists any longer for which I livea here.

sa: स कोपपावकस्तस्य शोकवायुसमीरितः। भीमसेनमयं दावं दिधक्षुरिव दृश्यते॥
en: Indeed, the fire of his anger, fanned by the wind of his grief, seemed then to be ready to consume the Bhima-forest.

sa: तद्धिरण्यमपर्यन्तमावृतं कुरुजाङ्गले। ईजानो वितते यज्ञे ब्राह्मणेभ्य: समार्पयत्॥
en: Collecting that vast wealth of gold that covered the Earth, Suhotra celebrated a sacrifice at Kurujangala and distributed it amongst the Brahmanas.

sa: शक्त्यृष्टिप्रासहस्तानां सहदेवं जिघांसताम्। संकल्पमकरोन्मोघं गाण्डीवेन धनंजयः॥ ते
en: With his Gandiva, Dharianjaya baffled the object of those warrior who, armed with darts and swords and lances, desired to kill Sahadeva.

sa: पञ्चाला निहताः सर्वे धृष्टद्युम्नपुरोगमाः। द्रुपदस्यात्मजाश्चैव द्रौपदेयाश्च पातिताः॥
en: All the Panchalas have been killed. Indeed, all the sons of Drupada, as also all the son of Draupadi, have been massacred.

sa: कनकोत्तमसंकाशो ज्वलन्निव विभावसुः। स शान्तः पुरुषव्याघ्र पार्थसायकावारिणा॥
en: There lay that best of men like a mass of pure gold or blazing fire extinguished with the water of Arjuna's arrows.

sa: तौ परस्परमासाद्य चित्रकार्मुकधारिणौ॥ मोघाविव यथोवृत्तौ दक्षिणोत्तरवर्षिणौ। शरतोयैः सिषिचतुस्तौ परस्परमाहवे॥ नान्तरं तत्र पश्यामि पाण्डवस्येतरस्य च।
en: These two heroes, both excellent bowmen, approaching, covered each other with downpours of arrows in that battle, like two pouring clouds risen in the sky on the south and the north. I could mark no difference between the son of Pandu and his antagonist.

sa: ते वध्यमानाः समरे पार्थनामाङ्कितैः शरैः॥ पार्थभूतममन्यन्त प्रेक्षमाणास्तथाविधम्।
en: Struck in that battle with arrows with Partha's name engraven on them those heroes regarded the battle field as full of Parthas.

sa: एवंमुक्त्वा सरिच्छ्रेष्टामूचुस्तेऽथ परस्परम्। विमोचयामहे सर्वे शापादेतां सरस्वतीम्॥
en: Having said so to that foremost of rivers, they then consulted with one another-"All of us shall release Sarasvati from her curse."

sa: आत्मा न शोचनीयस्ते श्लाघ्यो मृत्युस्तवानघ। वयमेवाधुना शोच्याः सर्वावस्थासु कौरव॥ । कृपणं वर्तयिष्यामस्तैींना बन्धुभिः प्रियैः।
en: You are not to be pitied! On the other hand, your death, O sinless one, is enviable! It is we that are objects of pity, O Kaurava! We shall have to carry on a miserable existence, shorn of all our dcar friends and kinsmen!

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा स्वेनानीकेन संवृतः॥ शल्यमेवाभिदुद्राव जिघांसुर्भरतर्षभः।
en: Then king Yudhishthira, accompanied by his soldiers, rushed against Shalya alone, with a view to kill him, O best of Bharata's race.

sa: अपध्वस्तस्त्ववमतो दुःखं जीवितमृच्छति। जीवेच्च यदपध्वस्तस्तच्छुद्धं मरणं भवेत्॥
en: Laden with infamy and insult, he has to carry on a miserable existence. A life of infamy, however, is tantamount to death.

sa: पुराहं राजशार्दूल तीर्थान्यनुचरन् प्रभो। समासादितवान् दिव्यं नरनारायणाश्रमम्॥
en: Formerly, O foremost of Kings, while sojourning among sacred places, I arrived O lord, at the beautiful hermitage of Nara and Narayana.

sa: मुहूर्तादिव संवृत्तं नीरजस्कं समन्ततः। वीरशोणितसिक्तायां भूमौ भरतसत्तम॥
en: That dust disappeared and everything became clear when the Earth, O best of the Bharatas, was covered with the blood of heroes.

sa: भीमसेनं त्रिभिर्विद्ध्वा कृतवर्मा शिलीमुखैः। बाणवर्षेण महता क्रुद्धरूपमवारयत्॥
en: Piercing Bhimasena with three arrows Kritavarman, discharging a mass of arrows, checked that warrior who was as if the personification of wrath.

sa: अकल्प्यन्त च मातङ्गा समनह्यन्त पत्तयः। रथानास्तरणोपेतांश्चक्रुरन्ये सहस्रशः॥
en: The elephants were also got ready. The infantry began to arm themselves. Thousands of attendants began to spread carpets on the cars.

sa: तादृशानां सहस्राणि प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च। अभिषिक्तं महात्मानं परिवार्योपतस्थिरे॥
en: Thousands and thousands, millions and millions, of such beings came there at the investiture of the great Kartikeya and stood encircling him."

sa: प्रलोभनार्थं तस्याथ प्राहिणोत् पाकशासनः। दिव्यामप्सरसं पुण्यां दर्शनीयामलम्बुषाम्॥
en: At last, for tempting the sage, the chastiser of Paka, sent to him the highly beautiful and celestial Apsara by name Alambusha.

sa: तस्मिंस्तथा वर्तमाने विद्रवे भृशदारुणे। युयुत्सुः शोकसम्मूढः प्राप्तकालमचिन्तयत्॥
en: During that general flight accompanied with fear, Yuyutsu, beside himself with grief, thought upon what he should do under the present circumstances.

sa: वातापिरिल्वलश्चैव त्रिशिराश्च तथा विभो॥ सुन्दोपसुन्दावसुरौ क्रिययैव निषूदितौ।
en: Likewise Vatapi and Ilwala and Trishiras, O lord and the Asuras Sunda and Upasunda were all killed by the aid of illusion.

sa: अवस्कन्दं करिष्यामि शिविरस्याद्य दुष्करम्। तानवस्कन्द्य शिविरे प्रेतभूतविचेतसः॥
en: Like Indra killing the Danavas, I shall, attacking them while dead in sleep in their camp, kill them all, by my power.

sa: गदायुद्धविशेषज्ञो गदायुद्धविशारदः। कृतवान् रौहिणेयो यत् तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: “Tell me, O Sanjaya, what Rohini's son, well-skilled in mace encounters and well acquainted with all its rules did on that occasion!"

sa: वीरबाहुविसृष्टाभिः शक्तिभिः परिधैरपि। खङ्गैश्च विविधैस्तीक्ष्णैः सशरैश्च शरासनैः॥
en: Behold, it is covered with darts and spikes discharged by heroic hands, and swords and various kinds of keen arrows and bows.

sa: मार्कण्डेयमुखात् कृत्स्नं यतिधर्ममवाप्तवान्। रामादस्त्राणि शक्राच्च प्राप्तवान् पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: He learnt the duties in full of the Yatis from Markandeya. That foremost of men learnt the science from Rama and Shakra.

sa: दीर्घसूत्रस्तु मन्दात्मा हीनबुद्धिरचेतनः। मरणं प्राप्तवान् मूढो यथैवोपहतेन्द्रियः॥
en: That fish, however, who had been idle. foolish, and senseless and without intelligence, and, therefore, unable to escape, met with his death.

sa: एवमेतदनादृत्य वर्तते यस्त्वतोऽन्यथा। स करोत्यात्मनोऽनर्थानेष बुद्धिमतां नयः॥
en: He, who, neglecting this rule about action, liveth otherwise, is said to injure himself. This is the opinion held by the intelligent.

sa: तथैव द्रोणपुत्रस्य तदस्त्रं तिग्मतेजसः। प्रजज्वाल महाज्वालं तेजोमण्डलसंवृतम्॥
en: Likewise the weapon that had been discharged by Drona's energetic son, blazed up with dreadful flames within a huge sphere of fire.

sa: अकृष्टपच्या पृथिवी भवन्त्योषधयस्तथा। त्वक्पत्रफलमूलानि वीर्यवन्ति भवन्ति च॥
en: The Earth yield crops without being cultivated and herbs and plants grow abundantly. Barks, leaves, fruits, and roots, become strong and profuse.

sa: अहमद्य गमिष्यामि वैरस्यान्तं सुदुर्गमम्। गदया पुरुषव्याघ्र हेमपट्टनिबद्धया॥
en: Today I will terminate these hostilities, with the help, O foremost of men, of my mace wrapped in a cloth of gold.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्ते व्याससहिताः सर्व ऋग्यजुःसामसहितैर्वचोभिः कृष्णमार्चयन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said, Then those great Rishis, with Vyasa amongst them, worshipped Krishna with hymns from the Richs, the Yajus, and the Samans.

sa: ब्राह्मणोऽपि यथान्यायं गुरुवृत्तिमनुत्तमाम्। चकार सर्वभावेन यदस्य मनसेप्सितम्॥
en: The Brahmana duly treated Prahlada as a disciple should his preceptor, and began with his whole heart to do what Prahlada wished.

sa: संगृहीतायुधान् वाहून् योधानामभिधावताम्। भल्लैश्चिच्छेद बीभत्सुः शिरांस्यपि हयानपि॥
en: Vibhatsu, with his broad-headed arrows, cut off the horses, the heads and the arms, with weapons in grasp, of those rushing warriors.

sa: उक्तानि कर्माणि बहूनि राजन् स्वाणि राजन्यपरायणानि। नेमानि दृष्टान्तविधौ स्मृतानि क्षाने हि सर्वं विहितं यथावत्॥
en: Many acts, O king, leading to heaven and especially fit for the Kshatriyas, have already। been mentioned. Those, however, cannot be referred to in reply to your present question for all of them have been duly laid down for such Kshatriyas who are merciless.

sa: स दृष्टमात्रो रामेण कृमि: प्राणानवासृजत्। तस्मिन्नेवासृजि क्लिन्नस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: As soon as Rama looked at it, the worm died melting in that blood which it had drawn. All this appeared wonderful.

sa: पुरुषस्य हि दृष्ट्वेमामुत्पत्तिमनिमित्ततः। यदृच्छया विनाशं च शोकहर्षावनर्थकौ॥
en: Beholding that the births and deaths of creatures take place without any perceptible cause and order, grief and joy are absolutely useless.

sa: सुनोभिश्च चित्राभिर्लाजैरुच्चावचैरपि। सर्वे स्विष्टतमं कृत्वा विधिवद् वेदपारगः॥
en: With various kinds of flowers and with fried paddy, of very superior kind, Dhaumya, well-versed in the Vedas, performed the remaining rites.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु सौभद्रमभिदुद्राव वीर्यवान्। सुकल्पितेनोह्यमानः स्यन्दनेन विराजता॥
en: Having thus spoken that highly puissant hero rushed upon Abhimanyu, borne on a resplendent chariot duly furnished with the implements of war.

sa: प्रामथ्नाद्धास्तिनपुरं वातो दक्षिणपश्चिमः। आरुजन् गणशो वृक्षान् परुषोऽशनिनिस्वनः॥
en: A gale from the south-west devastated the city of Hastinapura, uprooting clusters of trees; and there were loud sounds in the sky.

sa: प्रताप्य सेनामामित्री दीप्तैः शरगभस्तिभिः। बलिनार्जुनकालेन नीतोऽस्तं कर्णभास्करः॥
en: After having scorched his enemy's army the Karna-like sun, having arrows for its rays, was caused to be set by Arjuna time.

sa: आत्मनः प्रतिरूपैस्तैर्नानारूपैर्विमोहिताः। अन्योन्येनार्जुनं मत्वा स्वमात्मानं च जजिरे॥
en: Confounded by the various images of Arjuna's self, they fell to slay one another each considering the other to be Arjuna himself.

sa: येन यः प्रीयते देवः प्रीयन्ते पितरस्तथा। ऋषयः प्रमथा: श्रीश्च चित्रगुप्तो दिशां गजाः॥ ऋषिधर्मः स्मृतो यत्र सरहस्यो महाफलः। महादानफलं चैव सर्वयज्ञफलं तथा॥ यश्चैतदेवं जानीयाज्ज्ञात्वा वा कुरुतेऽनघ। सदोषोऽदोषवांश्चेह तैर्गुणैः सह युज्यते॥
en: What pleases deity, what pleases the departed manes, the Rishis, the companions of Mahadeva, the goddess Shri Chitragupta, and the powerful Elephants which rule the cardinal points of the compass, what forms the religion of the Rishis, the religion viz., which has many mysteries and which yields high fruits, the merits of what are called great gifts, and the merits of all the sacrifices he who knows these, O sinless one, and knowing acts according to his knowledge, becomes freed from stains if he has stains and acquires the inerits indicated.

sa: एवं प्रवृत्तो यदुपालभेत वै धनमाचार्याय तदनुप्रयच्छेत्। सतां वृत्तिं बहुगुणामेवमेति गुरोः पुत्रे भवति च वृत्तिरेषा॥
en: While in the position of a disciple, whatever wealth is earned should be given to the preceptor. It is by this means that he (the preceptor) earns his honest livelihood graced with many virtues. Such should also be the conduct of the preceptor's son.

sa: प्रहृष्टास्तावका राजन् सिंहनादान् विनेदिरे। ततस्तूर्यसहस्राणि नानालिङ्गानि भारत॥
en: Your warriors became filled with joy and they uttered loud and defiant war-cries. Then ) Bharata, thousands of drums of various sorts.

sa: तं वासवमिवायान्तं भूरिवर्षं शरौघिणम्। राजस्तावकसैन्यानां नोग्रं कश्चिदवारयत्॥!
en: None among your host ventured to oppose him, O monarch, as he came looking fierce and showering arrows like Vasava pouring rain.

sa: अथ नारायणाः कुद्धा विविधायुधपाणयः। क्षादयन्तः शरव्रातैः परिववर्धनंजयम्॥
en: Then the Narayana soldiers inflamed with rage and holding various weapons in their hands, encompassing Dhananjaya, covered him with showers of arrows.

sa: सुसंगृहीतस्त्वेवैष त्वया धर्मपुरोगमः। संसेव्यमानः शत्रूस्ते गृह्णीयान्महतो गणान्॥
en: This one, who always follows righteousness, has been a valuable acquisition. If treated by you with respect, he will subdue your enemies.

sa: तु लोहितदिग्धाङ्गा रक्तवर्मायुधाम्बराः॥ शस्त्रुस्तस्यां पपुश्चास्यां मम्लुश्च भरतर्षभ।
en: Their limbs, weapons and robes became all besmeared with blood. O foremost of Bharatas, some bathed in it, some drank its liquid.

sa: इति संचित्य मनसा श्रद्दधानः स्त्रिया वचः। बलाकाप्रत्ययेनासौ धयश्च वचनैः शुभैः॥ सम्प्रतस्थे स मिथिलां कौतूहलसमन्वितः।
en: Thus meditating in his mind and relying upon the statement of the woman, which was ensured by her knowledge of the death of the female crane, as also by her happy discourse bearing upon the principles of virtue, he (Kaushika), being filled with curiosity.

sa: अथ तौ सहितौ राजन्नन्योन्यविधिना ततः। विषयप्रतिसंहारमुभावेव प्रचक्रतुः।।१६
en: O king having done good to each other, the king and the Brahmana, withdrew their senses from the objects of the world.

sa: दुमाणां शिखराणीव दावदग्धानि मारिष। अश्ववृन्दान्यदृश्यन्त रथवृन्दानि भारत॥
en: O Sire, divisions of steeds and hosts of cars were seen there burnt like the tops of trees during a forest conflagration.

sa: रराज वसुधाऽऽकीर्णा विसर्पद्भिरिवोरगैः। क्षिप्तैः कनकचित्रैश्च नृपच्छत्रैः क्षितिर्वभौ॥
en: The earth, being strewn all over, seemed to be full of snakes, moving about, with the fallen royal umbrellas decked with gold.

sa: सत्यवसि चाक्षिसे त्वरमाणा महारथाः। प्रगृह्य विपुलं शस्त्रमभिमन्युमुपाद्रवन्॥
en: When Satyashravas had thus been pounced upon, the other mighty car-warriors, with haste taking up various kinds of weapons, rushed against Abhimanyu.

sa: ततः संशप्तकवातान् साश्वद्विपरथायुधान्। उवाह भगवान् वायुः शुष्कपर्णचयानिव॥
en: Then the almighty Vayu blew away hosts of the Samshaptakas consisting of steeds elephants, chariots and weapons like heaps of dry leafs.

sa: ततो भुजगसंकाशां सुशर्मा शक्तिमायसीम्। चिक्षेपार्जुनमादिश्य वासुदेवाय तोमरम्॥
en: Thereat Susarman, aiming at Arjuna, hurled an iron dart resembling a snake and he threw a lance at the son of Vasudeva.

sa: ह्रियते बुध्यमानोऽपि नरो हारिभिरिन्द्रियैः। विमूढसंज्ञो दुष्टाश्वैरुद्धान्तैरिव सारथिः॥
en: Men are lcd astray by their seducing senses, as a charioteer who has lost his senses (is led। astray) by wicked horses.

sa: एवं सम्पूज्य भगवानथर्वाङ्गिरसं तदा। व्यसर्जयन्महाराज देवराजः शतक्रतुः॥
en: The god having thus greeted Angirasa, the king of the gods, the performer of a hundred sacrifices dismissed him, O great king.

sa: शीतलच्छायमागम्य न्यचोधं गहने वने। क्षुत्पिपासापरीताङ्गाः पाण्डवाः समुपाविशन्॥
en: And afflicted with hunger and thirst, the Pandavas coming to a banian tree in that forest sat down in its cool shade.

sa: तमायान्तं महेष्वासं दुष्प्रसह्य दुरासदम्॥ हार्दिक्यस्तवरितो राजन् प्रत्यगृह्णादभीतवत्।
en: The Hridika's son, O king, quickly and fearlessly opposed that invincible warrior, that irresistible and powerful bowman, as he proceeded against them.

sa: उदीची पुनरावृत्य ययुर्भरतसत्तमाः। प्रादक्षिण्यं चिकीर्षन्तः पृथिव्या योगधर्मिणः॥
en: Turning next to the north, those foremost ones went on observant of Yoga, they were desirous of going round the whole earth.

sa: पश्यादित्यान् वसून् रुद्रानश्विनौ मरुतस्तथा। बहून्दृष्टपूर्वाणि पश्याच्चर्याणि भारत॥
en: Behold the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the Ashvins and the Maruts. Behold, 0 Bharata, innumerable wonders, not seen by you before.

sa: वासोभिर्बहुसाहौर्यो महात्मा पुरोचितः। मृगाजिने सोऽयमिह प्रवस्ते धर्ममाचरन्॥
en: He that used to adorn his person with attire worth many thousands (of things), engaged in observing morality, is clad in deer-skin.

sa: विचित्रकवचे तस्मिन् हते मद्रनृपानुजे॥ हाहाकारं प्रकुर्वाणाः कुरवोऽभिप्रदुद्रुवः।
en: Indeed, upon the destruction of the younger brother of the Madras clad in beautiful armour, the Kurus bewailed and fled away quickly.

sa: ततः प्रविशतस्तस्य विविधायुधधारिणः। विदुद्रुवुर्दिशः सर्वा दर्शनादेव देवताः॥
en: As soon as he, armed with various weapons, entered the field the celestials, at his very sight. And away to all directions.

sa: ततः शेषं समादाय कलत्रस्य महामतिः। हतभूयिष्ठरत्नस्य कुरुक्षेत्रमवातरत्॥
en: The high-souled one, taking with him the residue of the Vrishni women, and the wealth that was still with them, reached Kurukshetra,

sa: प्रस्थाप्य पुष्करं राजा वित्तवन्तमनामयम्। प्रविवेश पुरं श्रीमानत्यर्थमुपशोभिताम्॥
en: After having settled Pushkara and enriched and delivered him from all anxieties, the blessed prince entered his own palace, most gorgeously decorated.

sa: तं द्रोणदुर्योधनबालिकाश्च तथैव दुर्मर्षणचित्रसेनौ। नृपास्तथाऽन्ये प्रययुः समन्तात्॥
en: Drona, and Duryodhana, Balhika, Durmarshans, Chitrasena, the mighty Jayadratha and other royal heroes backed by a large number of troops accompanied him.

sa: हतारयः प्रनष्टेन्द्रा देवाः साग्निपुरोगमा:। विष्णुं त्रिभुवनेशानं मुहुर्मुहुरपूजयन्॥ त्वं गतिः परमेशान पूर्वजो जगतः पिता। रक्षार्थं सर्वभूतानां विष्णुत्वमुपजग्मिवान् ॥ हतश्चायं त्वया वृत्रो ब्रह्महत्या च वासवम्। बाधते सुरशार्दूल मोक्षं तस्य विनिर्दिश॥
en: Beholding the enemy slain and Indra fled, the deities headed by fire again and again chanted the glories of Vişņu —the lord of three worlds saying: O great god, you are the refuge of the three worlds. You are the first-born and the father of the universe. For protecting all creatures you have assumed this Vişnu from. You have slain this Vặtra but the sin of slaying a Brahmana has visited Indra. Therefore, O excellent Puruşa, do you so arrange that he may i be freed from sins.

sa: एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं सर्वविच्चासि मे मतः। महर्षिणाभ्यनुज्ञातो व्यासेनाद्भुतकर्मणा॥
en: I wish to hear this. I think that you know everything, having been taught by the great Rishi Vyasa of wonderful feats.

sa: ततः शक्रधनुःप्रख्यं धनुर्विस्फारयन्स्वयम्। आससाद नरेन्द्रस्तं रावणं क्रोधमूर्छितः॥
en: And then himself drawing his bow resembling the bow itself of Sakra, that foremost of sovereigns, beside himself with wrath, approached Rāvana.

sa: पीडितास्तु ततस्तस्य शैलस्तम्भोपमा भुजाः। विस्मिताश्चाभवंस्तत्र सचिवास्तस्य रक्षसः॥
en: Thereat his arms, resembling blocks of stone felt the shock and then there the councillors of that Rākşasa were struck with amaze.

sa: तथेतरे रणे यत्तास्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरजिह्मगैः। विव्यधुः समरे तूर्णं सौमदत्तिममर्षणम्॥
en: The rest of the brothers, then exerting their best in battle, pierced the irate son of Somadatta, each with ten straight-flyings arrows.

sa: गच्छन्तु चैवानयितुं दूताः शीघ्रजवैर्हयैः। भरतं मातुलकुलादद्यैव नृपशासनात्॥
en: Let messengers, with fast going steeds go today at the command of the king to fetch Bharata from his maternal uncle's house.

sa: तेषामापततामेव शिलायुद्धं चिकीर्षताम्। सात्यकिः प्रतिसंधाय निशितान् प्राहिणोच्छरान्॥
en: Satyaki sped at them sharp arrows fixing them on his bow string. That awful shower of stones then discharged by the Mountaineers.

sa: अभिमन्युस्तथा शूरो हैडिम्बश्च महारथः। भीमसेनश्च संक्रुद्धस्तेऽभ्यधावन्त कौरवान्॥
en: Thereafter, the valiant Abhimanyu, that mighty car-warrior, the son of Hidimba, and Bhimasena himself, all wrought up with wrath, assaulted the Kauravas.

sa: ब्रह्मलोकं चरत्वेक इन्द्रलोकं तथापरः। दिव्यवायुरिति ख्यातस्तृतीयोऽपि महायशाः॥
en: Let one range Brahmā's regions, and another Indra's, and the highly illustrious third also range around, being known as Divya Vāyu. (Ether).

sa: ततः सुप्रीतमनसौ ताबुभौ हरिराघवौ॥ अन्योन्यमभिवीक्षन्तौ न तृप्तिमभिजग्मतुः।
en: And with delighted hearts, both of them-the monkey and Rāghava began to gaze at each other, yet they did not feel satiated.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासस्तव पुत्रेण धन्विना। क्रोधसंरक्तनयनो वेगेनाक्षिप्य कार्मुकम्॥
en: Thus deeply pierced by your son, that fierce bow-man, with eyes red in rage and out of fury drawing his bow-string fiercely.

sa: अंशुकान्ताश्च कासांचिन्मुखमारुतकम्पिताः। उपर्युपरि वक्त्राणां व्याधूयन्ते पुनः पुनः॥
en: The scarf-ends of some stirred by the air that some on was blowing about their faces, flapped on them again and again.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुर्धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। भ्रातृभिः सहितः सर्वैरप्रमत्तोऽभवत् तदा॥
en: sons of Kunti, you should protect one another with great care from this day.” having said this, the mighty armed Dharmaraja Yudhisthira.

sa: दन्तैः पादैर्भुजैर्हस्तैः शक्तितोमरमुद्गरैः। येन तेनैव संक्रुद्धस्ताडयामास देवताः॥
en: And by him enraged, the celestials were assailed with his teeth, feet, arms, hands, Saktis, Tomaras and clubs or any weapon whatsoever.

sa: ततो गते भ्रातरि वासुदेवो जानन् सर्वा गतयो दिव्यदृष्टिः॥ वने शून्ये विचरंश्चिन्तयानो भूमौ चाथ संविवेशाग्र्यतेजाः।
en: After his brother had thus gone from the (human) world, Vasudeva of celestial vision, who was fully acquainted with the end of all things, wandered for sometime in that solitary forest thoughtfully. Gifted with great energy he then sat down on the naked earth.

sa: भ्रातृशोकाभिसंतप्तस्तृषया च प्रपीडितः। अभिदुद्राव पानीयं ततो वागभ्यभाषत॥
en: Sorely afflicted at the death of his brother and oppressed with thirst, as he made for the water he heard these words.

sa: ततो धनुषि संधाय शरमाशीविषोपमम्। पूरयामास तच्चापं कालचक्रमिवान्तकः॥
en: And fixing on his bow an arrow resembling a serpent, he stretched it like to Death drawing out his cycle of time.

sa: महता सिंहनादेन त्रासयन्तः पृथग्जनम्। अभिपेतुर्वधार्थं ते कालपर्यायचोदिताः॥
en: Urged by the perverse course of time, they fell upon that party, frightening it will loud leonine shouts and desirous of slaughter.

sa: हेतुयुक्ताः प्रकृतयो विकाराश्च परस्परम्। अन्योन्यमभिवर्तन्ते पुरुषाधिष्ठिताः सदा॥
en: The primordial essences, and their changes endued with causes, exist unitedly, on account of their being always presided over by the Soul.

sa: अद्य पश्यन्तु संग्रामे धनंजयममर्षणम्। विषक्तं मयि दुर्धर्षमश्मकूटमिवाश्मनि॥
en: Today let people see the irate and indomitable Dhananjaya collide with me, even like a mass of stone against another story mass.

sa: अथवा दर्शनीयाभिः प्रमदाभिर्विलोभ्यताम्। एकैकस्तत्र कौन्तेयस्ततः कृष्णा विरज्यताम्॥
en: We may tempt them with handsome girls; and on sceing which Krishna (Draupadi) will surely be annoyed with the sons of Kunti.

sa: न्यस्तमात्रस्य तस्याङ्के भुजावभ्यधिकावुभौ। पेततुस्तच्च नयनं न्यमज्जत ललाटजम्॥
en: As soon as the child was placed on his lap, his extra arms fell down and the eye on his forehead disappeared.

sa: तिष्ठतैवात्र संतुष्टा नोपवर्तितुमर्हथ। यदि प्राणैरिहार्थो वो निवर्तघ्नाः॥
en: Stay there content you should not move further. If you have a care for your lives, desist, you rangers of the night.

sa: ततः प्रत्यागतः कृष्णो धार्तराष्ट्रविसर्जितः। अक्रियायां नरव्याघ्र पाण्डवानिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Dismissed by Dhritarashtra's son Krishna came back and upon the failure of his mission, O foremost of kings, said to the Pandavas.

sa: तस्यामात्या गुणैरासत्रिक्ष्वाकोः सुमहात्मनः। मन्त्रज्ञाश्चेङ्गितज्ञाश्च नित्यं प्रियहिते रताः॥ अष्टौ बभूवुर्वीरस्य तस्यामात्या यशस्विनः। शुचयश्चानुरक्ताश्च राजकृत्येषु नित्यशः॥
en: That high-souled one of Ikşvāku's line had competent counsellors, capable of administering business, of diving into the motives of others, and ever intent upon the good of the monarch. And that heroic king had eight famous Counsellors, pure and devoted to the royal service.

sa: तैलद्रोण्यां तदामात्याः संवेश्य जगतीपतिम्। राज्ञः सर्वाण्यथादिष्टाश्चक्रुः कर्माण्यनन्तरम्॥
en: Then placing the corpse of the king in a (capacious) pan with oil, the courtiers performed the mourning rites of the monarch.

sa: ततोऽक्षहृदयं प्रादात् पाण्डवाय महात्मने। दत्त्वा चाश्वशिरोऽगच्छदुपस्प्रष्टुं महातपाः॥
en: Thereupon he taught the science to the illustrious son of Pandu. Having taught it, the great ascetic went to Asvasira to bathe.

sa: ततः शैलोत्तमस्याचं चित्रमाल्यधरं शिवम्। व्यपेतभयसम्मोहाः पश्यन्तु सुहृदस्तव॥
en: Then let your friends devoid of all fear and affliction behold the auspicious top of this excellent mountain decorated with variegated flowers.

sa: ततो मामब्रवीद् वीर दारुको विह्वलनिव। रथातव्यमिति तिष्ठामि शाल्वबाणप्रपीडितः। अवस्थातुं न शक्नोमि अझं मे व्यवसीदति॥
en: O hero, Daruka, who was about to faint away, spoke thus to me, “As it is my duty to stay, therefore I stay, though severely afflicted with the arrows of Shalva. But I am unable any longer to stay, my body has become weak."

sa: तान् सर्वान्धर्मराजस्य प्रेम्णा राजाम्बिकासुतः। प्रतिजग्राह विधिवद्धनैश्च समतर्पयत्॥
en: Out of affection for Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira), the king (Dhritarashtra) the son of Ambika, received them properly and gratified them with proper allowances.

sa: यथा च पुरुषव्याघ्रो दीर्घबाहुर्धनंजयः। वनं प्रविष्टस्तेजस्वी निर्मनुष्यमभीतवत्॥
en: How did that foremost of men, the mightyarmed and the greatly energetic Dhananjaya enter that solitary forest without having felt (any) fear?

sa: धनद उवाच युधिष्ठिरधृतिर्दाक्ष्यं देशकालपराक्रमाः। लोकतन्त्रविधानानामेष पञ्चविधो विधिः॥
en: The giver of wealth said : O Yudhishthira, steadiness, ability place and time-these four are the causes of success in human affairs,

sa: अस्मिन्नपि महारण्ये विजने दस्युसेविते। राष्ट्रादपेत्य वसतोधर्म स्तेनावसीदति॥
en: Even in this huge solitary forest frequented by robbers, living in banishment, deprived of your kingdom your virtue has suffered no decrease.

sa: सुहृद्भिर्वार्यमाणानां तेषां हि वपुराबभौ। आमिषादपकृष्टानां सिंहानामिव गर्जताम्॥
en: Though they were appeased by their friends, their faces glowed with anger, and they roared like lions driven away from their prey.

sa: नित्यमार्यामहं कुन्तीं वीरसूं सत्यवादिनीम्। स्वयं परिचराम्येतां पानाच्छादनभोजनैः॥
en: Every day I personally wait with food and drink and clothes upon the revered and truthful Kunti, the mother of those heroes.

sa: का च सर्वगुणोपेतं नाश्रयेत नलं नृपम्। यो वेदधर्मानखिलान् यथावच्चरितव्रतः॥ योऽधीते चतुरो वेदान् सर्वानाख्यानपञ्चमान्। नित्यं तृप्ता गृहे यस्य देवा यज्ञेषुधर्मतः। अहिंसानिरतो यश्च सत्यवादी दृढव्रतः॥ यस्मिन् दाक्ष्यंधृतिर्ज्ञानं तपः शौचं दमः शमः। ध्रुवाणि पुरुषव्याने लोकपालसमे नृपे॥ एवंरूपं नलं यो वै कामयेच्छपितुं कले। आत्मानं स शपेन्मूढो हन्यादात्मानमात्मना॥
en: Also what maiden would not accept Nala as her lord, who is endued with all (excellent) qualities, who is acquainted with all systems of religion, who is a strict observer of vows, who has studied the four Vedas as also the Puranas that are styled the fifth; in whose house the deities are always satisfied by Sacrifices performed in accordance with the rules prescribed for their observance; who never docs any harm to any one, who is truthful and of unshaken vows; in whom truthfulness, forgiveness, knowledge, rigid austerities, purity, self-control and quiescence are ever present; who is the foremost of kings, like the guardians of the worlds. O Kali, that foolish creature, that desires to imprecate Nala of this description, does surely curse his own self and does kill himself by his own agen

sa: एकादशविकारात्मा कलासम्भारसम्भृतः। मूर्तिमन्तं हि तं विद्धि नित्यं योगजितात्मकम्॥ तस्मिन् यः संस्थितो ह्यग्निर्नित्यं स्थाल्यामिवाहितः। आत्मानं तं विजानीहि नित्यं योगजितात्मकम्॥ देवो यः संस्थितस्तस्मिन्नबिन्दुरिव पुष्करे। क्षेत्रज्ञं तं विजानीहि नित्यं योगजितात्मकम्॥ जीवात्मकानि जानीहि रजः सत्त्वं तमस्तथा। जीवमात्मगुणं विद्धि तथाऽऽत्मानं परात्मकम्॥
en: Know that the soul is embodied in the corporeal disguise, in the eleven alloteopus conditions (of the animal system) and that though eternal, its normal state is apparently modified by its accompaniments even like the fire purified in its pan, eternal yet with its course altered by its surroundings; and that the divine thing which is kindred with the body is related to the latter in the same way as a drop of water to sleek surface of a lotus leaf on which it rolls; know that Sattva Raja and Tama are the attributes of all life. Life is the attribute of spirit and spirit again is the attribute of the Supreme Soul.

sa: असुरोरगरक्षांसि सत्त्वानि विविधानि च। आर्तनादमकुर्वन्त वध्यमानानि सागरैः॥
en: Being killed by the sons of Sagara, the Asuras, the Nagas, the Rakshashas and various other living creatures raised up distressful cries.

sa: अतीवरम्यां सुजला जातां पर्वतसानुषु। विचित्रभूतां लोकस्य शुभामद्भुतदर्शनाम्॥
en: Situated on the mountain, this charming sheet of water was the wonder of the world; it was beautiful and delightful to behold.

sa: ततश्चाष्टगुणं पार्थ प्राप्स्यसेधर्ममुत्तमम्। भीष्मः कुरूणां प्रवरो यथापूर्वमवाप्तवान्॥
en: O son of Pritha, you will get eight times superior merit to those that the foremost of the Kurus, Bhima formerly obtained.

sa: ततोऽहमब्रुवं नाहं दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि शत्रुहन्। मानुषेषु प्रयोक्ष्यामि विनास्त्रप्रतिघातनात्॥
en: Thereupon I replied, "O destroyer of foes, I will never hurt these celestials weapons at mortals except to ward off their weapons.

sa: नदतां काननान्तेषु श्रूयन्ते विविधाः स्वनाः। वृष्टिभिश्च्छाद्यमानानां वराहमृगपक्षिणाम्॥
en: The boars, the stage and the birds, drenched in water began to utter various sounds that could be heard in the forests.

sa: ईजे चाप्यश्वमेधेन ययातिरिव नाहुषः॥ अन्यैश्च बहुभिर्धीमान् क्रतुभिश्चातदक्षिणैः।
en: That talented one like Yayati the son of Nahusha held the horse and several other sacrifices, offering abundant gifts of the Brahmanas.

sa: आसादितमिदं घोरं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्। पाञ्चालीमपकर्षद्भिः सभामध्ये तपस्विनीम्॥
en: The wretches have brought on themselves this fearful, wholesale and horrible destruction by dragging into the Sabha the ascetic princess of Panchala.

sa: महाभ्रघनसंकाशं सलिलोपहितं शुभम्। मणिकाञ्चनरूप्यस्य शिलानां च समुच्चयम्॥
en: Looking like a mighty mass of clouds, abounding in sacred waters and consisting of a mass of gems, gold, silver and marble.

sa: ते मामालक्ष्य दैतेया विचित्राभरणाम्बराः। समुत्पेतुर्महावेगा रथानास्थाय दंशिताः॥
en: On beholding me, those sons of Diti, wearing various sorts of garments and mounted on chariots, rushed at me with great violence.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। प्रह्लादस्य च संवादं मुनेराङ्गिरसस्य च॥
en: The learned men quote as an example in connection with this matter the old history of Prahlada and the son of Angirasa.

sa: विसृज्यमानं चान्यत्र पुण्याहस्वन एव च। नाभुक्तवन्तं नापीतं नालङ्कृतमसत्कृतम्॥ अपश्यं सर्ववर्णानां युधिष्ठिरनिवेशने। अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि स्नातका गृहमेधिनः॥
en: At another place they are distributed; the sound of festivity is heard every where. I have not seen a single man amongst the four orders who had not got in Yudhishthira's palace food, drink, ornament and reception. Eighty eight thousand Snatakas leading domestic life.

sa: ततः सुदेवमाभाष्य दमयन्ती युधिष्ठिर। अब्रवीत् संनिधौ मातुर्दुःखशोकसमन्विता॥
en: Thereupon, O Yudhishthira, Damayanti summoned Sudeva; and overwhelmed with grief and calamity, she addressed him in the presence of her mother thus,

sa: दृष्ट्वेमं वृष्णिप्रवरं स्मृतिर्मामियामागता। आदिदेवमयं जिष्णुं पुरुषं पीतवाससम्॥
en: Seeing the chief of the Vrishnis, this Primeval Deity, this victorious God, wearing the yellow robe, my recollections come back to me.

sa: अन्यथा नोपतिष्ठेयं चीरकाषायवासिनी। नैवापवित्रो विप्रर्षे भूषणोऽयं कथंचन॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, I can not go to you with these rags dyed in red; to wear ornaments is never unholy.

sa: अश्वमेधसहस्रं च प्राप्यधर्मभृतां वरः। अन्यैश्च क्रतुभिर्मुख्यैरयजत् स्वाप्तदक्षिणैः॥
en: That foremost of all virtuous men, performed one thousand horse-sacrifices. He also performed many other sacrifices in which Dakshinas were in abundance.

sa: यथाक्रमविशेषेण सर्वाण्यायतनानि च। दर्शितानि द्विजश्रेष्ठा लोमशेन महात्मना॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, we have one after the other seen all the celebrated and sacred places with the high souled Lomasha.

sa: ततः प्रतिययुर्देवाः प्रतिमान्यधनंजयम्। यथागतेन विबुधाः सर्वे काममनोजवाः॥
en: Honouring Dhananjaya in return the celestials went back; all the deities capable of coursing at will went back from where they came.

sa: तस्य लाडूलनिनदं पर्वतः सुगुहामुखैः। उद्गारमिव गौर्नर्दनुत्ससर्ज समन्ततः॥
en: On all sides round, the mountain echoed through the mouths of its caves. Those sounds were like the lowings of a cow.

sa: उद्यतप्रतिपिष्टानां खङ्गानां वीरबाहुभिः। आसीत् सुतुमुलः शब्दः शरीरेष्वभिपात्यताम्॥
en: Loud was the clashing of swords upraised and warded off by the heroic hands, those that were aimed at one another's bodies.

sa: नारुन्तुदः स्यान्न नृशंसवादी न हीनतः परमभ्याददीत। ययास्य वाचा पर उद्विजेत न तां वदेदुषती पापलोक्याम्॥
en: No man should utter harsh words, and thus pierce the heart of others. No man should subjugate his enemies by dice and by such other foul means. No one should utter such words, as give pain and lead men to hell and annoys others.

sa: तथा रौद्रास्त्रनिष्पिष्टान् दिव्याभरणभूषितान्। निशम्य परमं हर्षमगमद् देवसारथिः॥
en: The charioteer of the gods (Matali), beholding them, that were decked with celestials ornaments, crushed by the Rudra weapon was highly pleased.

sa: वङ्गाङ्गविषयाध्यक्षं सहस्राक्षसमं बले। स्तुहि कर्णमिमं भीष्म महाचापविकर्षणम्॥
en: O Bhishma, praise this Karna, the king of Anga and Banga, who is like Indra in strength, who draws the great bow.

sa: ददृशुः पाण्डवा राजन् गन्धमादनमन्तिकात्। पृष्ठे हिमवतः पुण्ये नानाद्रुमलतावृते॥ सलिलावर्तसंजातैः पुष्पितैश्च महीरुहैः। समावृतं पुण्यतममाश्रमं वृषपर्वणः॥
en: Then, O king in the neighbourhood of the mountain Gandhamadana and on the sacred plateau of the Himalayas, decked with various sort of trees and creepers, the Pandavas beheld the most sacred hermitage of Vrishaparva encircled by blossoming trees growing near the water courses.

sa: तदिदं प्रतिगृहणीष्व अन्तर्धानं प्रियं मम। ओजस्तेजोद्युतिकरं प्रस्वायनमरातिनुत्॥
en: Take this favourite weapon of mine called Antardhana; this effulgent, mighty and powerful weapon is capable of sending the enemy to sleep.

sa: चत्वार्याहुनश्रेष्ठा व्यसनानि महीक्षिताम्। मृगयां पानमक्षांश्च ग्राम्ये चैवातिरक्तताम्॥
en: O best of men, it has been said that hunting, drinking, gambling, and enjoying women are the four vices of the kings.

sa: पञ्चानां पाण्डुपुत्राणामविज्ञातो महारिपुः। पञ्चानामिन्द्रियाणां तु शोकावेश इवातुलः॥
en: As grief is the greatest enemy of the objects of the five senses, so that unknown foe appeared to the five Pandavas.

sa: दद्यां वित्तं द्विजावयेभ्यः शत्रूणां चापि दुर्जयः। सख्यं च विष्णुना मे स्याद् भूतेष्वद्रोह एव च॥
en: 'Grant me the boon that I may give wealth to the best of the Brahmanas and that I may be unconquerable in respect to all enemies; and I may have friendship with Vishnu; and that I may not entertain any animosity against any body.

sa: देवराजस्य भवनं कृतकर्माणमाहवात्। हिरण्यपुरमुत्सृज्य निहत्य च महासुरान्॥
en: And successful in my mission, to the abode of the king of the gods. Having destroyed Hiranyapur and killed those mighty Asuras,

sa: सहदेव उवाच योधनानि च कन्याश्च युधि जित्वा महारथः। आजहार पुरा राजे राजसूये महाक्रतौ॥ यः समेतान् मृधे जित्वा यादवानमितद्युतिः। सुभद्रामाजहारैको वासुदेवस्य सम्मते॥ तस्य जिष्णोतसीं दृष्ट्वा शून्यामिव निवेशने। हृदयं मे महाराज न शाम्यति कदाचन॥ वनादस्माद् विवासं तु रोचयेऽहमरिंदम्। न हि नस्तमृते वीरं रमणीयमिदं वनम्॥
en: Sahadeva said: O king, O descendant of Bharata, seeing his bed of grass empty in our hermitage without that Jishnu, who, having vanquished powerful warriors in battle, won wealth and virgins and brought them to the king at the time of the great sacrifice, without that immeasurably effulgent hero who having vanquished singlehanded all the Yadavas took possession of Subhadra with the consent of Vasudeva (Krishna), who having invaded the kingdom of the illustrious Drupada, gave to the preceptor Drona his tuition-fee by securing for him half of Drupada's kingdom, my mind by no means gets any consolation. O chastiser of foes, to go away from this forest to some other forest is what I would prefer, for in the absence of that hero this forest can by no means be delightful.

sa: दक्षिणं सिन्धुमासाद्य ब्रह्मचारी जितेन्द्रियः॥ अग्निष्टोममवाप्नोति विमानं चाधिरोहति।
en: Going to the southern sea, he who practices Brahmacharya and conquers his passions obtains the fruit of Agnishtoma and ascends to heaven.

sa: ऋषयस्ते महात्मानः प्रत्यक्षागमबुद्धयः। कर्मभूमिमिमां प्राप्य पुनर्यान्ति सुरालयम्॥
en: The high-souled saints gifted with positive and intuitive knowledge being born in this world of actions attain to the celestials regions again.

sa: छिन्नशीर्षा विदेहाश्च भिन्नवगस्थिसंधयः। प्राणिनः समदृश्यन्त शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Hundreds and thousands of living creatures were seen with severed heads, with separated trunks, with their skin, bones and joints rent asunder.

sa: सेवितामृषिभिर्दिव्यैर्यक्षैः किम्पुरुषैस्तथा। राक्षसैः किन्नरैश्चापि गुप्तां वैश्रवणेन च॥
en: It was frequented by the celestials Rishis, the Yakshas, the Kimpurushas, the Rakshasas and the Kinniras. It was well-protected by Vaishravana (Kubera).

sa: ध्वजाश्चापि व्यशीर्यन्त भरतानामभूतये॥ दुर्योधनस्याग्निहोत्रे प्राक्रोशन भैरवं शिवाः।
en: All their flag staffs fell down, foreboding evil to the Bharatas. Jackals fearfully cried out within the sacred fire chamber of Duryodhana.

sa: आकाशनीकाशतटां तीरवानीरसंकुलाम्। बभूव चरतां हर्षः पुण्यतीर्थां सरस्वतीम्॥
en: And they experienced a great delight in wandering along the sacred Sarasvati whose banks resemble the firmament and are covered with canes.

sa: ते वध्यमाना गन्धर्वाः पाण्डवेन महात्मना। भूमिष्ठमन्तरिक्षस्थाः शरवर्षैरवाकिरन्॥
en: As the Gandharvas were killed by the illustrious Pandava, they hurled a heavy shower of weapons on Arjuna who was on earth.

sa: मोदयन् सर्वभूतानि गन्धमादनसम्भवः। सर्वगन्धवहस्तत्र मारुतः सुसुखो ववौ॥
en: A pleasurable breeze was blowing there, having its origin in the Gandhamadana, gladdening all creatures and carrying sweet odours of all kinds.

sa: ततस्त्वाज्ञापयामास पाण्डवोऽरिनिबर्हणः। सहदेव युधां श्रेष्ठं मन्त्रिणश्चैव सर्वशः॥
en: That chastiser of foes, the son of Pandu (Yudhishthira), commanded that foremost of all warriors, Sahadeva, and also all his ministers, saying.

sa: पुण्यकृद्भिर्महासत्त्वैस्तापसैः सह पाण्डवाः। तत् सर्वे भरतश्रेष्ठाः समूहुर्योगमुत्तमम्॥
en: And in company with the righteous and high-souled ascetics, the Pandavas, the best of the Bharatas, spent that juncture in excellent devotion.

sa: मूर्ध्नि चैनमुपाघ्राय देवेन्द्रः परवीरहा। अङ्कमारोपयामास प्रश्रयावनतं तदा॥
en: Smelling his head bent low in humility, the king of gods, the slayer of hostile heroes, made him sit on his lap.

sa: ततः कालायसं शूलं कण्टकैर्बहुभिश्चितम्। प्रगृह्याभ्यहनद्देवं स्तनयोरन्तरे दृढम्॥
en: Then taking up a javelin made of black iror girt with many a thorn, he furiously smote that deity on the chest.

sa: तस्याश्चाप्यनुरूपेयमशोकवनिका शुभा। शुभायाः पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य पत्नी रामस्य संमता॥
