en: Truly is this beautiful forest of Asoka the worthy abode of the beloved and chaste spouse of Rāma, the lord of men.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीद्दशग्रीवो न शोभनमिदं कृतम्। पूजिताः शत्रवो यस्माद्रव्यैरिन्द्रपुरोगमाः॥
en: Whereto the Ten-necked demon replied, You have not done well as you have worshipped, with diverse articles my enemies, Indra and others.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शब्दो भेरीशङ्खसमाकुलः। श्रुतो वै सर्वसैन्यानां कम्पयन्धरणीतलम्॥
en: In the meanwhile there was heard a mighty uproar occasioned by the whole host, and drums and conchs, which shook the earth.

sa: शृणु राम तथा वृत्तं तस्य तेजोबलं महत्। जघान शत्रून्येनासौ न च वध्यः स शत्रुभिः॥
en: Having regard to his (Indrajit's) energy and might, I shall relate to you the history of his race, in the light of which you will perceive why Rāvana's son had been capable of slaying his enemies, but could not himself be slain by them.

sa: राक्षसा मथिताः केचिद्वानरैर्जितकाशिभिः। प्रवेमू रुधिरं केचिन्मुखै रुधिरभोजनाः॥
en: Sparkling in the glory of victory, the monkeys crushed the Rākşasas and some among them feeding on gore began to vomit blood.

sa: निर्ददाह स तान्बाणान्रामकार्मुकनिःसृतान्। रावणस्य महाशूल: पतङ्गानिव पावकः॥
en: Then even as a flame consume insects, the mighty dart of Rāvana burnt up those shafts shot from the bow of Råma.

sa: चारप्रणिहितं युक्तं यदुक्तं सचिवैस्तव। अर्थस्यासंभवात्तत्र कारणं नोपपद्यते॥
en: And as regards the despatch of spies, anent what you have been advised by your ministers, I do not observe any utility.

sa: सतीभिर्वरनारीभिरेवं वाक्येऽभ्युदीरिते॥ नेदुर्दुन्दुभयः खस्थाः पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात च।
en: As soon as these words were uttered by those chaste damsels, bugles were sounded in heaven and flowery showers fell on earth.

sa: शरभस्त्वथ निश्चित्य सार्थं वचनमब्रवीत्। क्षिप्रमस्मिन्नरव्याघ्र चारः प्रतिविधीयताम्॥
en: There upon followed Sarava with words fraught with high import, best of men, do you speedily despatch emissaries to sound Vibhis ana.

sa: ताभ्यां स परिपूर्णाभ्यामुभाभ्यां राक्षसेश्वरः। शुशुभेऽचलसंकाशः शृङ्गाभ्यामिव मन्दरः॥
en: With both those well developed arms of his, the lord of Rākṣasas resembling a hill, looked handsome like Mandara with its summits.

sa: निबर्हयन्तश्चान्योन्यं ते राक्षसवनौकसः। भर्तारं न जहुयुद्धे संपतन्तस्ततस्ततः॥
en: And slaughtering one another the Rākşasas and the wood-rangers, rushing this way and that, did not (for a moment) leave their lords.

sa: शक्त्या ब्राया तु सौमित्रिस्ताडितोऽपि स्तनान्तरे। विष्णोरमीमांस्यभागमात्मानं प्रत्यनुस्मरत्॥
en: And hit at his chest by the dart of Brahmā, Sumitrā's son remembered that he was verily a portion of Vişņu himself.

sa: राजा दशरथो नाम रथकुञ्जरवाजिमान्। पुण्यशीलो महाकीर्तिरिक्ष्वाकूणां महायशाः॥
en: There reigned a noble and pious king named Dasaratha, highly glorious among the Ikşvākus, the lord of the warrior-cars, steeds and elephants.

sa: कैलासशिखराकारे त्रिकूटशिखरे स्थिताम्। लङ्कामीक्षस्व वैदेहि निर्मितां विश्वकर्मणा॥
en: O Vaidehi, do you behold Lanka, situate on the summit of the mount Citrakūta, resembling that of Kailasa and constructed by Viswakarma.

sa: रुधिरक्लिनगावस्तु लक्ष्मणः शुभलक्षणः। बभूव हृष्टस्तं हत्वा शत्रुजेतारमाहवे॥
en: Having in the conflict slain that conqueror of enemies, Lakşmaņa graced with auspicious marks, with his body bathed in blood, experienced delight.

sa: स च मेघाचलप्रख्यो वज्रायुधसमप्रभः। वरायुधधरो वीरो दिव्याभरणभूषितः॥
en: He was like to a collection of clouds, powerful as the thunder-bolt, holding an excellent mace, heroic and embellished with excellent ornaments.

sa: तदलं कालपाशेन सीताविग्रहरूपिणा। स्वयं स्कन्धावसक्तेन क्षेममात्मनि चिन्त्यताम्॥
en: Therefore, beware of yourself turning about your neck the fatal noose in the shape of Sītā! Do you rather study your welfare.

sa: तान्भक्षयित्वा तत्रस्थान्महर्षीन्यज्ञमागतान्। वितृप्तो रुधिरैस्तेषां पुनः संप्रययौ महीम्॥
en: Then devouring the Maharsis that were present at the place of sacrifice, Rāvana, satiated with their blood, again went to the earth.

sa: तानब्रवीत्ततो वाक्यं रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। चरान्प्रत्यायिकाशूरान्धीरान्विगतसाध्वसान्॥ इतो गच्छत रामस्य व्यवसायं परीक्षितुम्। मन्त्रेष्वभ्यन्तरायेऽस्य प्रीत्या तेन समागताः॥
en: Then the lord of Rākşasas, Rāvana, addressed the spies, who were heroic, faithful, calm, and courageous, Go hence, and acquaint yourselves with the exertions of Rama; as well as with those who, being the custodians of Rāma's close counsels, have gladly joined him (here).

sa: विविधायुधहस्ताश्च शूलमुद्गरपाणयः। गदाभिः पट्टिशैर्दण्डैरायसैर्मुसलैरपि॥ परिधैर्भिन्दिपालैश्च भल्लैः पाशैः परश्वधैः। निर्ययू राक्षसा घोरा नर्दन्तो जलदा यथा॥
en: And bearing various weapons in their hands, and wielding darts and clubs, and equipped with maces and bearded darts and rods and iron bludgeons and parighas and bhindipālas and lances and nooses and axes, those terrific Rāks asas sallied out roaring like to clouds.

sa: ततोऽभ्यनन्दन्संहृष्टाः समरे हरियूथपाः। तमप्रतिबलं दृष्ट्वा हतं नैर्ऋतपुङ्गवम्॥
en: Then the monkey-leaders, seeing that foremost of Naiſtas of unparalleled prowess slain in battle, began to gladly pay homage (to Lakş mana).

sa: अभग्नशिरसः केचिच्छिन्नैः पादैश्च बाहुभिः। शस्त्रैरर्दितदेहास्तु रुधिरेण समुक्षिताः॥
en: And some, with their heads unbroken, had their arms and legs torn; and their bodies pierced with weapons, and laved in blood.

sa: घोरं शूरजनाकीणं महाम्बुधरनिःस्वनम्। तदृष्ट्वा बलमायातं राक्षसानां दुरासदम्॥
en: Seeing the army of the Räkşasas incapable of being coped with advance, the monkey-forces began to move and send up loud cheers.

sa: कथंचिन्मृगशावाक्षी विश्वासमुपपादिता। ततः सम्भाषिता चैव सर्वमर्थं प्रकाशिता॥
en: And somehow creating her confidence I addressed that damsel having the eyes of a fawn and related to her the whole story.

sa: तदलं क्रूरवाक्यैश्च सान्त्वमेवाभिधीयताम्। अभियाचाम वैदेहीमेतद्धि मम रोचते॥
en: No more with rough words therefore; do you console the lady and humbly pray her to forgive you. This I think proper.

sa: तस्मिन्प्रतिहतेऽस्त्रे तु राघवेण महात्मना। रावणः क्रोधताम्राक्षः सौरमस्त्रमुदरीयत्॥
en: On that weapon being baffled by the highsouled Raghava, Rävaņa, with his eyes rendered coppery with passion took up a Solar weapon.

sa: ततः शतसहस्रेण हरिपुत्रं महाबलम्। जघान मर्मदेशेषु शरैरग्निशिखोपमैः॥
en: Then (Vajradanstra) with hundreds and thousands of shafts) resembling tongues of flames, pierced the powerful son of the monkey in the vitals.

sa: तौ परस्परमभ्येत्य सर्वगात्रेषु धन्विनौ। घोरैर्विव्यधतुर्बाणैः कृतभावावुभौ जये॥
en: And approaching each other, those bowmen, each setting his heart on victory, wounded each other all over the body with terrific shafts.

sa: अहं युष्मान्समाश्रित्य तपोनिधूतकल्मषान्। अनुगृहीतः पितृभिर्भविष्यामि सुनिवृतः। ५७।।
en: Having approached you who have shed his sins due to austerity, I shall be highly thankful to my ancestors and feel happy.

sa: प्रतिपूर्णमिवाकाशं संपूर्णेव च मेदिनी। लङ्कामुपनिविष्टैश्च संपतद्भिश्च वानरैः॥
en: The air was filled up, and the earth was covered quite with the monkeys coursing towards Lankā and dropping down into it.

sa: जघनं कपिसेनायाः कपिराजोऽभिरक्षतु।। पश्चार्द्धमिव लोकस्य प्रचेतास्तेजसा वृतः॥
en: As the Sun, surcharged with energy, protects the hind half of the globe, let the monkeymonarch protect the rear of the monkey-army.

sa: शूरः शूरेण संगम्य संयुगेष्वपराजितः। लक्ष्मणेन हतः शूरः पुत्रस्ते विबुधेन्द्रजित्॥ गतः स परमाल्लोकाशरैः संतर्घ्य लक्ष्मणम्।
en: That hero confronted by the (other) heros, has been vanquished in fight. And the hero, you son, the conqueror of the celestial chief, has also been slain by Lakşmaņa. And having gratified Lakş maņa with his shafts, he has repaired to the supreme regions.

sa: राक्षसैर्वानरा घोरा विनिकृत्ताः समन्ततः। वानरै राक्षसाश्चापि दुमैर्भूमिसमीकृताः॥
en: The Rākşasas began to scatter the dreadful monkeys on all sides; and the monkeys (on their parts) felled the Raksasas with trees.

sa: यथाशनिरवेभ्यस्तु जायतेऽथ प्रतिश्रुतिः। तथा तयोर्गदापोथैर्दिशः सर्वाः प्रतिश्रुताः॥
en: And all the quarters were resounded with the sound proceeding from the stroke of their clubs like to the sound of thunder-bolts.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरा हरयः कुमुदो नलः॥ मैन्दश्च परमक्रुद्धश्चक्रुर्वेगमनुत्तमम्।
en: In the meanwhile those heroes among the monkeys-Kumuda, Nīla and the exceedingly exasperated Mainda, summoned the utmost impetuosity they were masters of.

sa: कैलासशिखराकारे त्रिकूटशिखरे स्थिताम्। लङ्कामीक्षस्व वैदेहि निर्मितां विश्वकर्मणा॥
en: O Vaidehi, do you behold Lanka, situate on the summit of the mount Citrakūta, resembling that of Kailasa and constructed by Viswakarma.

sa: व्यथयन्राक्षसान्सर्वान्हर्षयंश्चापि वानरान्। स वानराणां मध्ये तु रामपार्श्वमुपागतः॥
en: Aggrieving the Rākşasas and rejoicing all the monkeys, he came back to the side of Rāma in the midst of the monkeys.

sa: तेऽदिता बाणवर्षेण महापार्श्वेन वानराः॥ विषादविमुखाः सर्वे बभूवुर्गतचेतसः।
en: The monkeys thus assailed by Mahāpārsva with a shower of shafts. All the monkeys were thus stricken with grief and rendered senseless.

sa: विद्युन्माली हतश्चात्र सुषेणेन महात्मना। लक्ष्मणेनेन्द्रजिच्चात्र रावणिनिहतो रणे॥
en: Vidyunmāli was slain there by the high souled Susena-and Indrajit, the son of Ravana, was slain there in the encounter, by Laksmana.

sa: स तु वैश्रवणस्तत्र तपोवनगतस्तदा। अवर्धताहुतिहुतो महातेजा यथानलः॥
en: Then the exceedingly energetic Vaiśravana, repairing to the wood of asceticism, increased in power) like to a fire fed by sacrificial oblations.

sa: ऋषिसङ्घस्तदाकाशे देवैश्च समरुद्गणैः। स्तूयमानस्य रामस्य शुश्रुवे मधुरध्वनिः॥
en: There was audible the sweet encomium of Rāma chanted by the crowd of ascetics in the sky, the celestials and the Marutas.

sa: जाज्वल्यमानो वपुषा तपनीयपरिच्छदः। मृगैश्चन्द्रार्धचन्द्रश्च स रथः समलंकृतः॥
en: The chariot was brilliant with its own native resplendence, adorned with gold and painted with the figures of deer and a cresent.

sa: नारायणगिरिं ते तु गर्जन्तो राक्षसाम्बुदाः। अर्दयन्तोऽस्त्रवर्षेण वर्षेणेवाद्रिमम्बुदाः॥
en: As clouds assail a mountain with showers, then the Raksasas, representing clouds, setting up shouts, began to assail Nārāyaṇa representing a mountain.

sa: तेषां शिरोधरान्धूताञ्छरध्वजधनूंषि च। रथान्पताकास्तूणीरांश्चिच्छेद स हरिः शरैः॥
en: Hari by means of his shafts cut off their necks, and arrows, and standards, and bows, and cars, and ensigns and quivers.

sa: काननानि सुरम्याणि नदीप्रस्रवणानि च। चरन रतिमाप्नोति त्वामपश्यन्नृपात्मजे॥
en: O daughter of a king, he is ranging at large in many a beautiful forest, river and fountain-but he finds delight nowhere.

sa: तानर्दयित्वा बाणौषैत्रासयित्वा च वानरान्। प्रजहास महाबाहुर्वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्॥
en: And tormenting the monkeys with volleys of shafts and striking terror into them, that mightyarmed one. bursting out into a laugh, said.

sa: वज्रदंष्ट्र हतं श्रुत्वा वालिपुत्रेण रावणः। बलाध्यक्षमुवाचेदं कृताञ्जलिमुपस्थितम्॥
en: Hearing Vajradanștra slain by the son of Vāli, Rāvaņa said to the general of his forces, standing before him with joined hands,

sa: हयैर्नागैस्तुरंगैश्च भग्नाक्षैश्च महारथैः। हतैश्च राक्षसैर्भूमी रुद्धमार्गा समन्ततः॥
en: And with horses and elephants, swift steeds, with broken wheels and mighty cars, and Raksasas slain, all the ways were blocked up.

sa: जनस्यास्याल्पभाग्यत्वाद्वलिनी श्वेतमूर्धजा। अकार्यमपहास्यं च सर्वलोकविगर्हितम्॥ राक्षसानां विनाशाय दूषणस्य खरस्य च। चकाराप्रतिरूपा सा राघवस्य प्रधर्षणम्॥
en: Alas for the misfortune of the Rākşasas, the aged Rākşasaee brought before him such a vile proposal, hated of all and worthy of creating laughter. for the destruction of Khara, Düşaņa and other Räksasas that ugly one approached Rāghava with such a vile intention.

sa: केचिल्लङ्कां परित्रस्ताः प्रविष्टा वानरार्दिताः। समुद्रे पतिताः केचित्केचित्पर्वतमाश्रिताः॥
en: And harassed by the monkeys, some hurriedly entered, Lankā, and some plunged into the sea, and some saught shelter in the mountains.

sa: सपर्वतनाकाशं दक्षिणां हरिवाहिनी॥ छादयन्ती ययौ भीमा द्यामिवाम्बुदसंततिः।
en: And as clouds envelope the sky, the mighty monkey-host went on, covering up the Southern quarter with its mountains, woods, and sky.

sa: तौ हन्यमानौ नाराचैर्धाराभिरिव पर्वतौ। हेमपुवानरव्याघ्रौ तिग्मान्मुमुचतुः शरान्॥
en: Being hurt with Nārāchas, like to mountains wet with rain, those two foremost of men, began to discharge shafts feathered in gold.

sa: शतं शङ्कुसहस्राणां महाशङ्कुरिति स्मृतः। महाशङ्कुसहस्राणां शतं वृन्दमिहोच्यते॥
en: An hundred of a thousand Sanku is known as a mahācanku. An hundred of a thousand Mahācanku is here termed a Vrinda.

sa: राशसांस्तर्पयिष्यामि हरीणां मांसशोणितैः। रामलक्ष्मणयोश्चापि स्वयं पास्यामि शोणितम्।।८०
en: I shall regale the Rākṣasas with the flesh and blood of the monkeys, and myself drink the blood of Rāma and Lakşmaņa.

sa: पृथिवीधरसंकाशो निपीड्य पृथिवीधरम्। पृथिवीं क्षोभयामास सार्णवां मारुतात्मजः॥
en: The offspring of the wind-god, resembling a mountain itself, bringing that mountain to sore straits, agitated the entire earth with her oceans.

sa: सा घूर्णितमहाद्वारा प्रभग्नगृहगोपुरा। लङ्का त्रासाकुला रात्रौ प्रनृत्येवाभवत्तदा॥
en: With her giant gateways shaking, and the doors of her edifices broken, that night Lankā, over-whelmed with fright, seemed to be dancing.

sa: न मेऽसि मित्रं न तथानुकम्प्यो न चोपकर्तासि न मे प्रियोऽसि। स्ततोऽसि वालीव वधार्ह वध्यः॥
en: O Rāvana, you are not my friend or an object of pity. You are not my benefactor, not are liked by me. You are Rāma's enemy, and you did therefore deserve to be slain by him like Vāli along with your friends and relatives.

sa: अथासनात्समुत्पत्य स्रजं गणिकृतान्तराम्। आबबन्ध महातेजाः कुम्भकर्णस्य रावणः॥
en: Then starting up form his seat, the exceedingly energetic Rāvana hung on Kumbhakarņa's neck a wreath stringed with gems in the centre.

sa: गदयाभिहतस्तेन मालिना गरुडो भृशम्। रणात्पराङ्मुखं देवं कृतवान्वेदनातुरः॥
en: On being severely struck by Mali with his mace, Garuda, writhing in torments, moved the god away from the field of battle.

sa: परित्यक्ष्याम्यहं प्राणान्वानराणां तु पश्यताम्। यदि पञ्चत्वमापन्नः सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः॥
en: If that enhancer of Sumitra's joy have met with his end, my life I must renounce in the sight of the monkeys.

sa: विद्युन्माली हतश्चात्र सुषेणेन महात्मना। लक्ष्मणेनेन्द्रजिच्चात्र रावणिनिहतो रणे॥
en: Vidyunmāli was slain there by the high souled Susena-and Indrajit, the son of Ravana, was slain there in the encounter, by Laksmana.

sa: बाढमित्येव ऋषयस्तमूचुर्भरतर्षभ। एवंवृत्ते तु संधाने वृत्रः प्रमुदितोऽभवत्॥
en: O best among the race of Bharata the Rishis said-"very well" and Vritra too became pleased with having peace under these conditions.

sa: स्मरन्ति तुभ्यं नरदेव संयुगे युद्धे च जिष्णोश्च युधां प्रणेतुः। समुत्कृष्टे दुन्दुभिशङ्खशब्दे गदापाणिं भीमसेनं स्मरन्ति॥
en: They remember, O god among men, your might in battle and remember also the one who always gets victories and is the leader in battles (Arjuna). They remember Bhimasena with the mace in his hand when there is sound of conch shells and drums.

sa: कान्दिग्भूतं छिन्नगात्रं विसंज्ञं दुर्योधनो द्रक्ष्यति सर्वसैन्यम्। हताश्ववीराग्रयनरेन्द्रनागं पिपासितं श्रान्तपत्रं भयार्तम्॥ आर्तस्वरं हन्यमानं हतं च विकीर्णकेशास्थिकपालसंघम्। प्रजापतेः कर्म यथार्थनिष्ठितं तदा दृष्ट्वा तप्स्यति मन्दबुद्धिः॥
en: When Duryodhana sees all his soldiers overpowered and runring away all sides with their bodies cut open, senseless and his horses, commanders rulers killed, his army thirsty, struck with fear, crying piteously for help, dead and dying, with their animals rendered faint and hair, bones and heads strewn about as if they were really the work of the Lord of creatures; then will that man of weak intellect repent.

sa: बुद्धौ कलुषभूतायां विनाशे प्रत्युपस्थिते। अनयो नयसंकाशो हृदयानापसर्पति॥
en: On intellect becoming dim and on the approach of ruin, wrong, in the disguise of right, dose not remove from the mind.

sa: दृश्यमाना हरिभिर्बलिभिर्दूरपातिभिः। निहताः सर्वशो राजन् महीं जग्मुर्गतासवः॥
en: O king, when disclosed to view, all of them being slain by the powerful and long-leaping monkeys fell dead on the ground.

sa: मुहूर्तमरणास्त्वन्ये मानुषा मृगपक्षिणः। तैर्यग्योन्याश्च ये चान्ये जीवलोकचरास्तथा॥
en: Others there are that die in a short time, namely beings, animals, birds and creatures having their birth among other living beings.

sa: वने जाता: शापदग्धस्य राज्ञः पाण्डोः पुत्राः पञ्च पञ्चेन्द्रकल्पाः। त्वयैव बाला वर्धिताः शिक्षिताश्च तवादेशं पालयन्त्याम्बिकेय॥
en: The king Pandu, burning under the influence of a curse, begot in the woods, five sons each equal to Indra; under your supervision did the boys grow up and were instructed and you have been rearing them up to now, O son of Ambika.

sa: एतान्यनिगृहीतानि व्यापादयितुमप्यलम्। अविधेया इवादान्ता हयाः पथि कुसारथिम्॥
en: These (the senses) when untrained lead one to destruction; in the same way the untrained horses lead the unskillful drivers (to destruction.)

sa: स वानरमहासैन्यः पूर्णसागरसंनिभः। निवेशमकरोत् तत्र सुग्रीवानुमते तदा॥
en: Then the mighty monkey-army, looking like a sea full of the brim, took up their quarters there at the command of Sugriva.

sa: तमापतन्तं संक्रुद्धं पुनरेव युयुत्सया। अभिदुद्राव सौमित्रिविभीषणमते स्थितः॥
en: (And) as he (Indrajita) desirous of battle, was advancing wrathfully, the son of Sumitra, at the advice of Vibhishana rushed at him.

sa: तमायान्तं महाबाहुं जिगीषन्तं रणे कुरून्। अभ्यवारयदव्यग्रः कूरकर्माऽऽपगासुतः॥
en: The patient Bhishma (the son of river) withstood the mighty armed Arjuna advancing with a view to vanquish the Kurus in battle.

sa: अभिपत्याथ बाहुभ्यां प्रत्यगृह्णादमर्षितः। मातङ्ग इव मातङ्गं प्रभिन्नकरटामुखम्॥
en: Throwing each other down with their arms and then again seizing in great anger, they fought like two elephants with rent temples.

sa: शिबिराणि कुरुक्षेत्रे क्रियन्तां वसुधाधिपाः। सुपर्याप्तावकाशानि दुरादेयानि शत्रुभिः॥
en: Let the rulers of the earth fix their tents in Kurukshetra-tents which are spacious and large, and incapable being captured by enemies.

sa: पृथग्भूताः पाण्डवानां पञ्चालानां रथव्रजाः। आयान्तमभिनन्दन्ति कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Hosts of cars belonging to the Panchalas are coming separately and inspire joy into the heart of Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti.

sa: साम्ना जितोऽर्थोऽर्थकरो भवेत युद्धेऽनयो भविता नेह सोऽर्थः॥
en: A point gained by peaceful means is really beneficial, that gained by war is not a gain at all-it is only injurious.

sa: शारद्वतस्यावसथं स्म गत्वा महारथस्यात्मविदां वरस्या त्वं मामभीक्ष्णं परिकीर्तयन् वै कृपस्य पादौ संजय पाणिना स्पृशेः॥
en: Going to the residence of the son of Sharadvata, of mighty prowess and the chief among those who have a knowledge of self, you should again and again greet him on my behalf and touch the feet of Kripa, O Sanjaya, with your hands.

sa: ततो रामेण समरे द्वन्द्वयुद्धमुपागमम्। स हि रामभयादेभिर्नागरैर्विप्रवासितः॥
en: Then did I engage myself in a single combat with Rama and he fled away from the city from fear of Rama.

sa: स सायकमयैर्जालैरर्जुनस्य रथं प्रति। भानुमद्भिः शिलाघौतैर्भानोराच्छादयत् प्रभाम्॥
en: Then shooting at Arjuna's car a goodly number of sharp arrows, bright as the sun, he covered the rays of the sun.

sa: इशितज्ञास्ततो भर्तुश्चत्वारो रजनीचराः। चतुर्भुङ्गेषु जगृहुः शार्दूलमिव पक्षिणः॥
en: Thereupon four night-wanderers who understood (well) the signs of their lord seized Angada by his four limbs like birds seizing a tiger.

sa: अधीयीत ब्राह्मणो वै यजेत दद्यादीयात् तीर्थमुख्यानि चैवा अध्यापयेद् याजयेच्चापि याज्यान् प्रतिग्रहान् वा विहितान् प्रतीच्छेत्॥
en: A Brahmana should be steady, perform sacrificial ceremonies, give alms and go to the principal places of pilgrimage; he should also teach and officiate as priest in the ceremonies performed by others who need his help and should accept donations from well known persons.

sa: किमहं पूर्वमेवेह भवता नाभिचोदितः। उपायोऽत्र महानस्ति येनैतदुपपद्यते॥
en: Why have not I been informed (of your purpose) before; there is every good means by which you will gain your object.

sa: तानवेक्ष्य कृशान् पौत्रान् वने वन्येन जीवतः॥ महर्षिरनुकम्पार्थमब्रवीद्वाष्पगद्गदम्।
en: Seeing his grandson lean and living on forest produce, that great Rishi, moved by compassion spoke thus in accents choked with tears.

sa: मुत्सृज्य शत्रून् विनिवर्तमानम्। विराटराष्ट्राभिमुखं प्रयान्तं नाशक्नुवंस्तं कुरवोऽभियातुम्॥
en: The Kauravas could not withstand Arjuna, when, after dispersing the enemies, he proceeded towards Virata's city, like an elephant with rent temples.

sa: यथान्यायं कौशलं वन्दनं च समागता मद्वचनेन वाच्याः। इदं ब्रूयाः संजय राजमध्ये सुयोधनं पापकृतां निधानम्॥
en: The assembled ones are to be asked in my name about their health each in terms suitable to his rank and the proper greetings are to be presented. Tell this, O Sanjaya, in the midst of those kings to the foremost of sinners, Suyodhana.

sa: राजा दशरथश्चैव दिव्यभास्वरमूर्तिमान्। विमानेन महाहेण हंसयुक्तेन भास्वता॥
en: And king Dasharatha also in his celestials appearance and robes and mounted on a highly-resplendent and bright car (appeared on the scene).

sa: त्वदर्शनमभिप्रेप्सुरिह प्राप्तो विहायसा। राजपुत्रौ कुशलिनौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
en: Desirous of seeing you, I have come here ranging through the firmament. Those princes, the brothers Rama and Lakshmana are all right,

sa: ततस्तमतिकोपेन साश्चं सरथसारथिम्। धूम्राक्षमवधीत् क्रुद्धो हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः॥
en: Then the angry Hanuman the son of Pavana fired with a mighty rage, destroyed Dhumraksha together with his horses charioteer and car.

sa: अर्थानामीश्वरो यः स्यादिन्द्रियाणामनीश्वरः। इन्द्रियाणामनैश्वर्यादैश्वर्याद् भ्रश्यते हि सः॥
en: The lord of riches, who is a slave of his senses, loses his riches through his want of control over the senses.

sa: ततः सर्वान् समानाय्य द्विजानाश्रमवासिनः। यथाविधि समुद्वाहं कारयामासतुनृपौ॥
en: Then, those two monarchs, inviting all the Brahmanas dwelling in the hermitages, caused the wedding to be celebrated agreeably to the usage.

sa: लक्ष्या परमया युक्तं पुरन्दरगृहोपमम्। विचित्रैरासनैर्युक्तं प्रविवेश जनार्दनः॥
en: Janardana entered the house which was furnished very sumptuously and was like the mansion of Purandara, furnished with diverse kinds of seats.

sa: गोपध्याक्षो भयत्रस्तो रथमास्थाय सत्वरः। जगाम नगरायैव परिक्रोशंस्तदाऽऽर्तवत्॥
en: Greatly stricken with grief the chief, of the cow-herds, quickly got upon a chariot and started for the city bewailing in affliction.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच तथा प्रशस्य ह्यभिपूज्य चैव वरस्त्रियं तामृषयः समागताः। नरेन्द्रमामन्त्र्य सपुत्रमञ्जसा शिवेन जग्मुर्मुदिताः स्वमालयम्॥
en: Markandeya said : The assembled sages, then, having eulogised and paid their adorations to that most exalted lady and having taken leave of that most excellent of kings together with his son, soon left for their respective asylums in peace and with merry hearts.

sa: तस्य देहविनिष्क्रान्ताः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। राक्षसाः प्रत्यदृश्यन्त शरशक्त्वृष्टिपाणयः॥
en: (Thereupon) hundreds and thousands of Rakshasas, armed with arrows, lances and double-edged swords, issuing out of his body appeared (on the scene).

sa: भिन्नैश्च परुषैः पादैः सव्रणैः शोणितोक्षितैः। कुशकण्टकविद्धाङ्गावुन्मत्ताविव धावतः॥
en: And with their feet torn, cracked, wounded and bleeding and pierced by thorns and Kusha blades they ran about like mad men.

sa: सेयमापन्महाघोरा कुरुष्वेव समुत्थिता। उपेक्ष्यमाणा कौरव्य पृथिवीं घातयिष्यति॥
en: This exceedingly grave has its rise among the Kurus and if regarded with indifference, it will destroy the whole earth, O Kaurava.

sa: देवासुरमनुष्याश्च गन्धर्वोरगराक्षसाः। अस्मिन् युद्धे सुसंक्रुद्धा हनिष्यन्ति परस्परम्॥
en: The gods, the Asuras, the human beings, the Gandharvas and the Rakshasas will, in this battle in their race, kill one another.

sa: गृहे स्थापयितव्यानि धन्यानि मनुरब्रवीत्। देवब्राह्मणपूजार्थमतिथीनां च भारत॥
en: Are always to be kept in a blessed houseManu has said-for the proper worship of the gods, the Brahmanas and guests, OBharata.

sa: तस्य जिष्णुरुपावृत्य पृथुधारेण कार्मुकम्। चकर्त गापत्रेण जातरूपपरिष्कृतम्॥
en: Confronting him, Vishnu with a greatly sharpened arrow with the wings of a vulture, cut off his bow made of burnished gold.

sa: ततो रावणमभ्येत्य राक्षसी दुःखमूर्च्छिता। पपात पादयोर्धातुः संशुष्करुधिरानना॥
en: Then that Rakshasas-woman senseless with grief and with marks of dry blood on her face, approaching Ravana, fell down at his feet.

sa: मृतं पुत्रं दुःखपुष्टं मनुष्या उत्क्षिप्य राजन् स्वगृहान्निर्हरन्ति। तं मुक्तकेशाः करुणं रुदन्ति चितामध्ये काष्ठमिव क्षिपन्ति॥
en: Men after having taken away a dead son tended with greatest care, O king, set out from their own houses; and with the hair hanging loose they mourn for him piteously and then throw him into the funeral pyre like a piece of wood.

sa: सर्वे चैते कृतवैराः पुरस्तात् त्वया राजानो हृतसाराश्च कृष्ण) तवोद्वेगात् संश्रिता धार्तराष्ट्रानं सुसंहताः कर्णेन वीराः॥
en: All these (kings) too have before this been made enemies of by yourself; for you have, O Krishna, dispossessed these kings of their wealth; out of fear of you these heroes have come under the protection of the sons of Dhritarashtra and joined Karna.

sa: यश्चाशिष्यं शास्ति वै यश्च तुष्येद् यश्चातिबेलं भजते द्विषन्तम्। स्त्रियश्च यो रक्षति भद्रमश्नुते यशायाच्यं याचते कत्थते वा ॥ यश्चाभिजातः प्रकरोत्यकार्य यश्चाबलो बलिना नित्यवैरी। अश्रद्दधानाय च यो ब्रवीति यश्चाकाम्यं कामयते नरेन्द्र॥ बध्वावहासं श्वशुरो मन्यते यो वध्वा वसन्नभयो मानकामः। परक्षेत्रे निर्वपति यश्चबीजं स्त्रियः च यः परिवदतेऽतिवेलम्॥ यश्चापि लब्ध्वा न स्मरामीति वादी दत्त्वा च यः कत्थि याच्यमानः। यश्चासतः सत्त्वमुपानयीत एतान् नयन्ति निरयं पाशहस्ताः॥
en: (The seventeen kinds of men are), he who seeks to control one incapable of being brought under control; he who is satisfied with trifling gains; he who serves his enemies; he who controls women; he who asks favours that ought not to be asked; he who boasts, having done very little good; he who, well born, does improper acts; he who through week is always struggling with one who is powerful; he who talks to one listening with disgust; he who desires what ought not to be desired, O chief among men; he who being a father-in-law cracks jokes with his daughter-in-law; he whose fears being dispelled by his daughter-inlaw desires to be respected; he who sows his own seeds in the ground of another; and he who speaks very ill of his wife; he who having obtained a favour from another says he does no

sa: सर्वमागमयामास पाण्डवानां विचेष्टितम्। धृतराष्ट्रात्मजो राजा गूढैः प्रणिहितैश्चरैः॥
en: The son of Dhritarashtra, himself a king, by sending scouts, privately, came to know all that had been done by the Pandavas.

sa: न चाहमुत्सहे कृष्णमृते लोकमुदीक्षितुम्। ततोऽहमनुवामि केशवस्य चिकीर्षितम्॥
en: I do not dare to look on this world separated from Krishna and therefore shall I remain inactive in what Krishna wishes.

sa: प्रयास्यतां पाण्डवानां ससैन्यानां समन्ततः॥ गड्डेव पूर्णा दुर्धर्षा समदृश्यत वाहिनी। अग्रानीके भीमसेनो माद्रीपुत्रौ च दंशितौ॥
en: And the Pandavas moving about, looked like the Ganga troubled by great waves and full to the brim. The army seemed to be hard to vanquish. In front of the army were Bhimasena and the two sons of Madri clad in coats of mail,

sa: ततो हते दशग्रीवे देवाः सर्षिपुरोगमाः। आशीर्भिर्जययुक्ताभिरानचुस्तं महाभुजम्॥
en: The ten-necked being slain, the celestials with the Rishis at their head eulogised the mighty-armed one by uttering blessings indicative of victory,

sa: कीचकोऽयं हतः शेते गन्धर्वैः पतिभिर्ममा परस्त्रीकामसम्मत्तस्तत्रागच्छत पश्यत॥
en: Delighted and having her grief removed, said to the guards of the assembly-hall; 'This Kichaka has been slain by my Gandharva husbands.

sa: उच्चं पर्वतमारूढो भीमकर्मा वृकोदरः। गदापाणिर्नरव्याघ्रो ग्रसन्निव महीमिमाम्॥
en: Vrikodara, of terrible actions, having ascended a high mountain, that best among men, mace in hand, stood as if swallowing this earth.

sa: तथा राजन्यो रक्षणं वै प्रजानां कृत्वा धर्मेणाप्रमत्तोऽथ दत्त्वा। यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा सर्ववेदानधीत्य दारान् कृत्वा पुण्यकृदावसेद् गृहान्॥
en: In the same way, having protected his kingdom and his subjects, making donations to persons leading a holy life and performing sacrificial ceremonies and studied all the Vedas and taken a wife (a Kshatriya) should become a house holder continuing to do virtuous deeds.

sa: आमुक्तकवचैर्युक्तैः सपताकैः स्वलङ्कतैः। सादिभिश्चोपपन्नास्तु तथा चायुतशो हयाः॥
en: It was also made up of tens of thousands of horse soldiers clad in mail, with ornaments on and holding up flags.

sa: क्षताश्च बहुभिः शस्त्रैर्युद्धशौण्डैरनेकशः। मण्डलानि विचित्राणि विचेरुस्ते मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: They were also mangled with numerous weapons by many foremost of combatants. Then they began to move in various wonderful circular motions.

sa: नाराचैर्दशभिर्भीमस्तान् निहत्य तवात्मजान्॥ कर्णस्य दयितं पुत्रं वृषसेनमवाकिरत्।
en: Having destroyed those (ten) sons of your with ten arrows Bhima covered Vrishasena, the beloved son of Karna (with downpours of shafts).

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासः कर्णेनबलिनां वरः॥ घोरमादत्त विशिखं कर्णकायावदारणम्।
en: Then pierced by Karna the great bowman, the foremost of the strong, took up a dreadful arrow capable of piercing Karna's body.

sa: बाणशङ्खरवांश्चक्रुः सिंहनादांश्च पुष्कलान्। भीमसेनस्ततो राजन् धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः॥
en: Began to make loud sounds with their arrows and conches conches and they uttered tremendous war-cries. Then Bhimasena and Prisata's son Dhristadyumna.

sa: ततस्त्वरितमागम्य कृतवर्मा तवात्मजम्। प्रत्यपद्यत राजानं निमग्नं व्यसनार्णवे॥
en: Thereupon Kritavarman, most quickly approaching towards your son, got near that prince, who was then drowned in the great ocean of calamity.

sa: तमापतन्तं परिघं वज्रशनिसमस्वनम्॥ चिच्छेद बहुधा कर्णः शरैराशीविषोपमैः।
en: Then the serpentine arrow Karna sundered into pieces Parigha that was about to fall making a sound like that of a thunderbolt.

sa: समादधन्माहाबाहुर्गाण्डीवे क्षिप्रमर्जुनः॥ तस्मिन् संधीयमाने तु शरे ज्वलनतेजसि।
en: Namely the mighty-armed Arjuna, placed it on the Gandiva's string. When that shaft of fiery effulgence was fixed on the bow string.

sa: क्लृप्तं तु तं रथं दृष्ट्वा विस्मिता देवताऽभवन्॥ सर्वलोकस्य तेजसिं दृष्ट्वैकस्थानि मारिष। युक्तं निवेदयामासुर्देवास्तस्मै महात्मने।॥
en: The celestials also, after having looked at that excellently equipt car, became greatly astonished. O sire, the celestials, after having seen that the energies of the entire universe were united together in one place, informed that high-souled one (Brahman) that the car was ready.

sa: पुनश्चासृजदुग्राणि शरवर्षाणि पाण्डवः। तस्य तान्याददे कर्णः सर्वाण्यस्राण्यभीतवत्॥
en: The son of Pandu then once more shot showers of dreadful arrows; and Karna also dauntlessly received all those weapons of his.

sa: सात्यकिं च ततस्तूर्णं केकयानां महारथः। शरैरनेकसाहस्त्रैर्बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्॥
en: The mighty car-warrior of the Kaikeya troops then pierced Satyaki in his arms and chest most rapidly with several thousands of arrows.

sa: भीमेन गिरिवाणं मालवस्येन्द्रवर्मणः। उपसृत्य तदा द्रोणमुच्चैरिदमुवाच ह॥
en: By Bhima an elephant belonging to Indravarman the ruler of the Malavas and that was huge as a hill, approached Drona and

sa: तं नृशंसेन पापेन क्रूरेणादीर्घदर्शिना। श्रुत्वा निहतमाचार्यमश्वत्थामा किमब्रवीत्॥
en: What, alas, did Ashvatthman say, hearing that the Preceptor has been slain by that sinful, cruel and mean Dhristadyumna of little foresight?

sa: अथार्जुनं स्वे परिवार्य सैनिकाः पुरन्दरं देवगणा इवाब्रुवन्। अभैष्म यस्मान्मरणादिव प्रजाः स वीर दिष्ट्या निहतस्त्वयारिपुः॥
en: After a short while, the heroic warriors, after having surrounded Arjuna, even like the celestials encompassing Purandara, addressed him, saying 'O hero, that enemy, of whom we were greatly afraid like the creatures being afraid of death itself, had now been slain by you.'

sa: पुनरप्याह तेजस्वी पार्थः कृष्णमरिंदमम्। चोदयाश्चन हृषीकेष कालोऽयमतिवर्तते॥
en: Partha of great prowess again told Krishna who was the scorcher of foes "O Hrishikesa, time flies, so spur on the steeds".

sa: क्षरतः शोणितं भूरि शस्त्रच्छेददरीमुखैः। दरीमुखैरिव गिरीन् गैरिकाम्बुपरिस्रवान्॥
en: Are shedding a profusion of blood through the openings caused by weapons, as mountains discharge through the caves streams of liquid chalk.

sa: दर्शयित्वाऽऽत्मनो रूपं रुदोपेन्द्रसमं युधि॥ पाण्डवानामनीकानि प्रगृह्यसौ व्यशातयत्।
en: Assuming the form, of Rudra or that of Upendra in battle, he afflicted the Pandava detachment and played a havoc with them.

sa: पर्यष्वजत् तदा कृष्णावानन्दाश्रुपरिप्लुतः। प्रमृज्य वदनं शुभ्रं पुण्डरीकसमप्रभम्॥
en: And with his eyes full of tears of joy he embraced Krishna and Arjuna; and wiping his white face of lotus-like lustre.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नोऽभ्ययात् क्रुद्धः प्रगृह्य महतीं चमूम्। चण्डवाताभिसृष्टानामुदधीनामिव स्वनः॥
en: Dhristadyumna, followed by a large army, proceeded wrathfully (towards him). Like the roar of waters dashed into fury by a terrible hurricane.

sa: तान् सूतपुत्रो विशिखैर्दशभिर्दशभिः शरैः। रथेश्चारुचरन् वीरः प्रत्यविध्यदरिंदमः॥
en: Moving about in his car the heroic son of the charioteer, the subduer of foes, pierced each of them with ten arrows.

sa: संजय उवाच हैडिम्बि निहतं दृष्ट्वा विशीर्णमिव पर्वतम्।
en: Sanjaya said Beholding Hidimva's son slain and lying like a riven hill all the Pandavas began to shed copious tears of grief.

sa: दुर्योधनो युधामन्योर्ध्वजमेकेषुणाच्छिनत्। एकेन कार्मुकं चास्य चकर्त तनयस्तव॥
en: Then with a single arrows Duryodhana cutoff the standard of Yudhamnya; and then with another arrow your son cut-off the latter's bow.

sa: संस्तूयमानो तौ वीरौ तदास्तां द्युतिमत्तसौ॥ ऋत्विक्सदस्यैरिन्द्राग्नी स्तूयमानाविवाध्वरे।
en: Eulogised those two highly effulgent heroes shone like Indra and Agni (fire-god) adored with hymns in a sacrifice by Ritvikas and Sadasyas.

sa: ततः कमलपत्राक्षः सिंहदंष्ट्रो दुरासदः। सात्यकि शसंक्रुद्धः सोमदत्तमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Then the greatly powerful Satyaki endued with eyes (beautiful) as lotus petals and possessed of leonine teeth greatly enraged thus addressed Somadatta.

sa: ततो भीमो महाबाहुर्नवभिनतपर्वभिः। प्रेषयामास संक्रुद्धः सूतपुत्रस्य मारिष॥
en: Thereupon, O sire, Bhima excited to the highest pitch of fury, sped at the son of Suta nine shafts of depressed knots.

sa: ततस्तूर्यसहस्राणि भेरीणामयुतानि च॥ वाद्यमानान्यराजन्त मेघशब्दो यथा दिवि।
en: Ten thousands of trumpets and ten thousand drums simultaneously struck and produced a sound resembling the muttering of clouds in the sky.

sa: नाकम्पत महाबाहुस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्। अचिन्तयन् वै स शरान्नात्यर्थं सम्भ्रभावली॥
en: Did not tremble in the least; that indeed appeared wonderful. Then that powerful hero thought fearlessly of the shafts he should use.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नश्च राधेयं द्रौपदेयाश्च मारिष परिवब्रुरमित्रघ्नं शतशश्चापरे जनाः॥
en: Dhristadyumna, the sons of Droupadi and hundreds of other heroes, O Sire, speedily encompassed the son of Radha, the slayer of foes.

sa: स तेजसा शस्त्रकृतेन पूतो महाहवे देहवरं विसृज्य। आक्रामदूर्ध्व वरदो वरा) व्यावृत्त्य धर्मेण परेण रोदसी॥
en: Purified through his prowess and death by the edge of weapons and in consequence of the boon accorded to him, Bhurisravas worthy of every boon went to the regions on high, shuffling off his mortal coil and filling the heavens with his illustrious fame.

sa: अपश्यन्नम्भसः पारं निपतंश्च श्रमान्वितः। पातवेगप्रमथितो हंसं काकोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: Not beholding the limit of the ocean, fatigued and broken down with the exertion of flight the crow said to the swan.

sa: असितो देवलश्चैव नारदश्च महातपाः। पितामहश्च मे व्यासस्त्वामाहुर्विधिमुत्तमम्॥
en: You are explained as the best creator (Vidhi) by the sages like Asita, Devala, the great austerious Narada and my grand-father Vyasa.

sa: तपनीयनिभौ चित्रौ कल्पवृक्षाविवाद्धातौ। किंशुकाविव चोत्फुल्लौ व्यकाशेतां रणाजिरे॥
en: Like a pair of highly graceful and radiant Kalpa trees or a couple of Kinsuka trees rich with their burden of flowers.

sa: तथापरान् नरश्रेष्ठ संदष्टौष्ठपुटान् पुनः। भृकुटीकुटिलैर्वक्त्रैः प्रेक्षमाणान् समन्ततः॥
en: O majesty! Look at the other warriors staring all around with chewing their lips within teeth and brows cured on their faces.

sa: प्रत्यक्षं वृष्णिशार्दूलं पाढम्पर्शमिवोरगः॥ स भवांस्तत्र यात्वाशु यत्र कर्णो महारथः। अहमेनं हनिष्यामि मां वैष मधुसूदन॥
en: Under my very nose, foremost of the Vrishnis, even as a snake cannot bear the tread of human feet. So, do you take me there where the mighty Karna is fighting. Oslayer of Madhu, either I will slay him or he shall slay me.

sa: दश नागपतीनीषां धृतराष्ट्रमुखांस्तदा। योक्त्राणि चक्रुर्नागांश्च निश्वसन्तो महोरगान्॥
en: The ten princes of snakes, headed by one, named Dhritarashtra, that were were all very powerful constituted the shafts of that car.

sa: ततः प्रहस्याधिरथिस्तूर्णमस्य शिलाशितैः। व्यधमद् भीमसेनस्य शरजालानि पत्रिभिः॥
en: Thereupon Adhiratha's son, smiling (in contempt) tore away Bhima's net-work of arrows, by means of his own winged shafts whetted on stone.

sa: क्रुद्धमाधिरथिं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रास्तव विशाम्पते। भीमसेनममन्यन्त वैश्वानरमुखे हुतम्॥
en: Then, 0 ruler of men, beholding Adhiratha's son excited with rage, your sons considered Bhimasena to be a libation poured on fire.

sa: भुजैश्छिन्नैर्महीपाल हस्तिहस्तोपमैर्मधे। समाकीर्णा मही भाति पञ्चास्यैरिव पन्नगैः॥
en: The earth then covered over with loppedoff arms and thousands of mangled bodies, appeared beautiful as if covered over with charming flowers.

sa: अथैनं कोष्ठकीकृत्य सर्वतस्ते महारथाः। सिंहनादांस्ततश्चक्रुस्तर्जयन्ति स्म सात्यकिम्॥
en: Having thus impaled the Satvata hero, all those mighty warriors filled the directions of the compass with the echo of their war-cries.

sa: शतमेकं च पातानां पताम्यहमनुस्मर। श्लाघमानस्त्वमात्मानं काक भाषितवानसि॥
en: “O crow, how did you praise yourself. Remember, you said that you would course through the sky in a hundred different ways.

sa: वृकोदरस्ततः कर्णं त्रिभिर्भल्लैः समाहितः। आकर्णपूर्णैरभ्यघ्नद् बाह्वोरुरसि चानदत्॥
en: Thereupon Vrikodara, with due caution, pierced Kara on the breast and the arms, with three broad-headed shafts shot from a fulldawn bow.

sa: त्रस्तान् कुन्तीसुतान् दृष्ट्वा द्रोणसायकपीडितान्। मतिमाश्रेयसे युक्तः केशवोऽर्जुनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then beholding the sons of Kunti dismayed and afflicted by the arrows of Drona the intelligent Kesava ever solicitous of the welfare

sa: दुर्योधनं त्रिभिर्बाणैरभ्यविध्यत् स्तनान्तरे। चित्रसेनं शतेनैव दशभिर्दुःसहं तथा॥
en: He pierced Duryodhana on the centre of his chest with three arrows; he pierce Chitrasena with hundred and Dussaha with ten arrows.

sa: बीभत्सुदक्षिणं पार्श्वमुत्तरं च वृकोदरः। भारद्वाजं शरौघाभ्यां महद्भयामभ्यवर्षताम्॥
en: Vibhatsu attacking the right and Vrikodara the left flank (of your army), discharged at the son of Bharadvaja mighty downpours of shafts.

sa: नदन् यथा वज्रधरस्तपान्ते ज्वलन् यथा जलदान्ते च सूर्येः। निघ्नन्नमित्रान् धनुषा दृढेन स कम्पयंस्तव पुत्रस्य सेनाम्॥
en: Uttering thundering roars like the clouds at the expiration of the summer season or burning like the sun at the end of the rainy season, he began to slaughter his foes by means of his tough bow and caused the troops of your son repeatedly to tremble.

sa: सरस्वतीवाससमा कुतो रतिः सरस्वतीवाससमाः कुतो गुणाः। सरस्वतीं प्राप्य दिवं गता जनाः सदा स्मरिष्यन्ति नदीं सरस्वतीम्॥
en: Where is such happiness as is obtainable by living by the Sarasvati? Where else such merits as those obtainable by living by the Sarasvati? Men have departed for heaven, having approached the Sarasvati! All should ever remember the Sarasvati! Sarasvati is the most sacred of all rivers.

sa: ऐश्वर्याणि च सर्वाणि देवगन्धर्वरक्षसाम्। भूतयक्षविहङ्गानां पन्नगानां च सर्वशः॥ पूर्वमेवादिदेशासौ निकायेषु महात्मनाम्। समर्थं च तमैश्वर्ये महामतिरमन्यत॥
en: He had formerly given away to the gods all kinds of wealth over which the great celestials, the Gandharvas, the Rakshasas, ghosts, Yakshas, birds and snakes now region. Brahman, therefore, considered that youth as fully qualified to have the dominion which had been bestowed upon the gods.

sa: मूढमैन्द्रियकं लुब्धमनार्यचरितं शठम्। अनतीतोपधं हिस्त्रं दुर्बुद्धिमबहुश्रुतम्॥ त्यक्तोदात्तं माद्यरतं यतस्त्रीमृगयापरम्। कार्ये महति युञ्जानो हीयते नृपतिः श्रिया॥
en: On the other hand, the king becomes shorn of prosperity by appointing to important offices men who are fools and slaves of their senses, who are covetous and of disreputable conduct, who are deceitful and hypocritical, who are minded, and addicted to drink, gambling, women, and hunting.

sa: ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदानानि नानारूपाणि पार्थिव॥ हयादीनां प्रकृष्टानि तेऽध्वानं यान्ति वै नराः। संनिवार्यातपं यान्ति छत्रेणैव हि छत्रदाः॥
en: O ruler of earth, O king, those that have given horses and other good conveyances to the Brahmanas, go along (this path) on those animals and conveyances. Those that have given. umbrellas thus (to the Brahmanas) go along this path with umbrellas, warding off the sun's rays.

sa: जन्म द्वितीयमित्येजज्जघन्यतरमुच्यते। भित्त्वा तु पृथिवीं यानि जायन्ते कालपर्ययात्॥ उद्भिज्जानि च तान्याहुर्भूतानि द्विजसत्तमाः। द्विपादबहुपादानि तिर्यग्गतिमतीनि च॥ जरायुजानि भूतानि विकृतान्यपि सत्तमाः। द्विविधा खलु विज्ञेया ब्रह्मयोनिः सनातनी॥ तपः कर्म च यत्पुण्यमित्येष विदुषां नयः। विविधं कर्म विज्ञेयमिज्या दानं च तन्मखे॥ जातस्याध्ययनं पुण्यमिति वृद्धानुशासनम्। एतद् यो वेत्ति विधिवद् युक्तः स स्याद् द्विजर्षभाः।।
en: This is said to be the second mode of birth and is inferior. Those living creatures which take birth after the lapse of sometime, bursting through the earth, are said to be germ-born beings, O foremost of twice-bom persons! Creatures of two fect or of many fect, and those which move crookedly, are the beings born of wombs. Among them are some which are deformed, you best of men! The eternal womb of Brahma should be known to be of two kinds, viz., penance and meritorious acts. Such is the doctrine of the learned. Action should be understood to be of various kinds, such as sacrifice, gifts made at sacrifices, and the meritorious duty of study for every one that is born; such is the teaching of the ancients. He who duly understands this, comes to be considered as possessed of Yoga, you chief

sa: ततस्तस्मिन् गृहे मुख्ये नानारत्नविभूषिते। मेरुमन्दरसंकाशे नानामङ्गलशोभिते ॥ प्रदीप्तमग्निमुत्सृज्य लाङ्गुलाग्रे प्रतिष्ठितम्। ननाद हनुमान् वीरो युगान्तजलदो यथा॥
en: And in that foremost of mansions, adorned or with various gems, resembling Meru Mandara, graced with diverse auspicious things, he set to the same, fire flaming at the end of his tail. And the heroic Hanumān roars, resembling a cloud (appearing) at the end of a Yuga.

sa: भ्राता मम महातेजा वीर्यवानतिधार्मिकः। कुशध्वज इति ख्यातः पुरीमध्यवसच्छुभाम्॥ वार्याफलकपर्यन्तां पिबन्निक्षुमती नदीम्। सांकाश्यां पुण्यसंकाशां विमानमिव पुष्पकम्॥
en: My highly energetic, puissant and eminently righteous brother known by the name of Kusadhvaja dwell in the auspicious city, Sāņkāśyā, whose ramparts are ranged round with pointed weapons, and which is laved by the river Ikşumatī, and which resembles the celestial regions or the aerial car, Pușpaka.

sa: भवन्तश्चापि विक्रान्ताः प्रमाणं सर्व एव हि। प्रमाणमेनं संस्थाप्य पश्यध्वं पश्चिमां दिशम्॥ कृतकृत्या भविष्यामः कृतस्य प्रतिकर्मणा।।
en: All of you possessed of prowess, yourselves certainly constitute the measure whereby to ascertain the wisdom or otherwise of a course. Making this one also into a measure, survey the western quarter. Having requited the good that has been done to us, we shall attain our end.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच ये दानशीला न प्रतिगृह्यते सदा न चाप्यर्थोश्चाददते परेभ्यः। येषामदेयमर्हते नास्ति किंचित् सर्वातिथ्या: सुप्रसादा जनाश्च॥ ये क्षन्तारो नाभिजल्पन्ति चान्यान् सत्रीभूताः सततं पुण्यशीलाः। तथाविधानामेष लोको महर्षे परं गन्ता धृतराष्ट्रो न तत्र॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Those men who always make gifts without receiving any gift, who never accept any service from others, who possess nothing which they cannot give to a worthy person, who are hospitable to all creatures, who are inclined to show favour to every one, who are of for giving dispositions, who never speak ill of others, who protect all creatures by covering them with mercy, and who are always righteous in their conduct, only those men, O great Rishi, go to such regions. I shall go to a higher region. Indeed, Dhritarashtra shall not go there.

sa: अष्टक उवाच तांस्ते ददामि मा प्रपत प्रपातं ये मे लोका दिवि राजेन्द्र सन्ति स्तानाक्रम क्षिप्रमपेतमोहः॥
en: Ashtaka said: O king, I give to you all those regions in heaven or in the firmament that are for me to enjoy. Therefore, though falling, you must not fall. Take them soon, wherever they may be, in heaven or in the firmament. Let your sorrow cease.

sa: लब्ध्वा रथं धनुश्चैव तथाक्षय्ये महेषुधी॥ बभूव कल्यः कौन्तेयः प्रहृष्टः साह्यकर्मणि। वज्रनाभं ततश्चक्रं ददौ कृष्णाय पावकः॥
en: Having obtained that chariot and bow and the two inexhaustible quivers the son of Kunti became exceedingly glad; and he then thought that he was competent to assist Agni in the task. Then (Agni) gave Krishna a discuss with a piece of iron attached to its centre.

sa: त्वदृते हि जगत् कृत्स्नं सद्यो नश्येद्भुताशन। तुभ्यं कृत्वा नमो विप्राः स्वकर्मविजितां गतिम्॥ गच्छन्ति सह पत्नीभिः सुतैरपि च शाश्वतीम्। त्वामग्ने जलदानाहुः खे विषक्तान् सविद्युतः॥
en: O eater of the sacrificial ghee, this whole universe will be destroyed in a single day if you were not present in it. Bowing down to you, the Brahmanas, accompanied by their wives and children, go to the eternal regions acquired by them by their own (good) deeds. O Agni, the learned say that you are the clouds charged with lightning. The flames put forth by you consume every creatures, (on earth).

sa: अष्टक उवाच किंस्वित् कृत्वा लभते तात लोकान् मर्त्यः श्रेष्ठांस्तपसा विद्यया वा। च्छुभाँल्लोकान् येन गच्छेत् क्रमेण॥
en: Ashtaka said: O sire, how does a man attain to those higher regions whence there is no return to earthly life again? Is it by asceticism or knowledge? How does a man attain to the region of the highest bliss? As I ask you, tell me all.

sa: अर्धासनेन शक्रस्य राज्यार्धेन च पार्थिवः। वन्द्यमानः सुरगणैः प्रतिज्ञामध्यरोहत।।।। तस्य पापमभिप्रायं विदित्वा पाकशासनः। सान्त्वपूर्वमिदं वाक्यमुवाच युवनाश्वजम्॥
en: With this promise, the king Mândhāta went into the celestial region that he would occupy the half of Indra's throne and kingdom and the celestials would adore him. Being apprised of this vicious intention of his, Indra, the slayer of Pāka, consoled him in sweet words, saying.

sa: यदाश्रौषं नागबलैः सुदुःसहं द्रोणानीकं युयुधानं प्रमथ्य। यातं वार्ष्णेयं यत्र तौ कृष्णपार्थों तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Yuyudhana of the Vrishni race went back to the place where Krishna and Arjuna were, after having thrown the army of Drona into disorder, having none to withstand the attack on account of powerful elephant.

sa: प्रत्यघ्नस्तरसा वेगं समरे हयसादिनाम्। उद्वृत्तस्य महाराज प्रावृट्कालेऽतिपूर्यतः॥ पौर्णमास्यामम्बुवेगं यथा वेला महोदधेः। ततस्ते रथिनो राजञ्छरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Quickly checked the furious charge of those horsemen in battle, like, O mighty monarch, the banks withstanding the waves of the mighty main swollen with the waters of the rainy season on the day of the full moon. Thereupon, O king, these car-warriors, with their straightknotted shafts,

sa: भारद्वाजस्ततस्तूर्ण पाण्डवानां महाचमूम्। दारयामास समरे शतथोऽथ सहस्रशः॥ शिखण्डी तु महाराज द्रौणिमासाद्य संयुगे। आजधान भ्रुवोर्मध्ये नाराचैस्त्रिभिराशुगैः॥
en: Thereafter in that battle, the son of Bharadvaja resisted, by hundreds and by thousand the mighty army belonging to the sons of Pandu. Shikhandin also, O mighty sovereign encountering the son of Drona in the conflict, wounded him between the brows with three swift coursing long shafts.

sa: यच्छुत्वा निहतं द्रोणं शतधा न विदीर्यते। ब्राह्ये दैवे तथेष्वस्त्रे यमुपासन् गुणार्थिनः॥ ब्राह्मणा राजपुत्राश्च स कथं मृत्युना हृतः। शोषणं सागरस्येव मेरोरिव विसर्पणम्॥ पतनं भास्करस्येव न मृष्ये द्रोणपातनम्। दुष्टानां प्रतिषेद्धाऽऽसीद् धार्मिकाणां च रक्षिता॥
en: Since it does not break into hundred pieces, although I have heard of the slaughter of Drona. How could he had bean struck by death, on whom the Brahmanas and the princes danced attendance being desirous of receiving lessons in the Vedas and in divination and in the use of bows. I cannot even conceive the fall of Drona which is like the drying up of the ocean, the removal of the Meru mountain and the dropping of the lustrous orb from the heavens. He was the repressor of the wicked and the protector of the pious.

sa: विस्मिताश्च प्रहृष्टाश्च क्षत्रधर्मं निशम्य ते। स्वधर्म निन्दमानास्ते प्रणिपत्य महात्मने॥ शयनं कल्पयामासुर्भीष्मायामितकर्मणे। सोपधानं नरव्याघ्र शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: o lord of men, at the thought, they wondered and were delighted; and in obedience to their sectarian duties, they bowed down to the illustrious Bhishma. Then those foremost of men prepared for Bhishma of infinite energy a bed furnished with a pillow, made of close-knotted arrows.

sa: सर्ववित् सर्वजित् सिद्धो भव भावविवर्जितः। संयमेन नवं बन्धं निवर्त्य तपसो बलात्। सम्प्राप्ता बहवः सिद्धिमप्यबाधां सुखोदयाम्॥
en: Possessed of oinniscience and the master of all things, may you be successful, and do you become freed from all existent objects. Through subjugation of their senses and the power of their penances, many persons, having destroyed the fetters of action, acquired great success and uninterrupted happiness.

sa: ततो द्रक्ष्यसि सर्वेषां भूतानां प्रभवाप्ययौ। एनं वै सर्वभूतेभ्यो विशिष्टं मेनिरे बुधाः। धर्मं धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठा मुनयस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः॥
en: Wise men consider such an act to be the foremost of all things. Indeed, this act of crossing the river of life is considered by the foremost of pious persons, by ascetics conversant with the truth, to be the greatest of all acts that one can perform.

sa: प्रजाः सृष्टा मनसा कर्मणा च द्वावेवैतौ सत्पथौ लोकजुष्टौ। दृष्टं कर्म शाश्वतं चान्तवच्च मनस्त्यागः कारणं नान्यदस्ति॥
en: Creatures have all been engendered by Mind and Act. These are the two best paths adored of all. External acts yields fruits that are both transitory as also eternal. For acquiring the latter there is no other means than relinquishing the desire for fruits by the mind,

sa: यदेव योगाः पश्यन्ति तत् सांख्यैरपि दृश्यते। एकं सांख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स तत्त्ववित्॥
en: What the Yogins have in view is the very same which the Sankhyas also have in view. He who sees both the Sankhya and the Yoga systems to be one and the same is to be considered as truly conversant with the principles that ordain the universe.

sa: यश्चेदं शृणुयान्नित्यं यश्चैनं परिकीर्तयेत्। नमो भगवते कृत्वा समाहितमतिर्नरः॥ भवत्यरोगो मतिमान् बलरूपसमन्वितः। आतुरो मुच्यते रोगाद् बद्धो मुच्येत बन्धनात्॥ कामान् कामी लभेत् कामं दीर्घ चायुरवाप्नुयात्।
en: He, who, having uttered the words-'I bow to the holy Lord',-frequently listens, with rapt attention, to this discourse or reads or recites it to others, becomes gifted with intelligence and health, and possessed of beauty and strength If ill, he becomes freed from that illness; if fettered, freed from his bonds. The man who has desires gets (by this) the fruition of all his desires, and easily acquires a long life also.

sa: सृष्टिप्रलयसंयुक्तमाचायैः परिदर्शितम्। यज्ज्ञात्वा पुरुषो लोके प्रीतिं सौख्यं च विन्दति। फललाभश्च तस्य स्यात् सर्वभूतहितं च तत्॥
en: Great teachers have (before this) described the Creation and the Destruction of the universe). Knowing those truths, a person may acquire, even in this world, great satisfaction and happiness. Such knowledge also bring on the acquisition of great fruits, and it is highly beneficial to all creatures.

sa: समैर्विवाहं कुरुते न हीनैः समैः सख्यं व्यवहारं कथां च। गुणैविंशोष्टांश्च पुरो दधाति विपश्चितस्तस्य नयाः सुनीताः॥
en: One, who forms matrimonial relationship with a man in equal station and not with those who are below him and who forms friendships with his equals and converses and treats with them, who puts those that are graced with accomplishments before him-performs acts after the best policy.

sa: आत्मा नदी भारत पुण्यतीर्था सत्योदका धृतिकूला दयोर्मिः। तस्यां स्नातः पूयते पुम्यकर्मा पुण्यो ह्यात्मा नित्यमलोभ एव॥
en: The soul is as the river, O Bharata, having several holy spots; truth is as its waters; selfcontrol, its banks; and kindness, its waves; the man of virtuous acts purifies himself be a bath therein; the soul is pure and the absence of desire is a virtue.

sa: यम उवाच निवर्त तुष्टोऽस्मि तवानया गिरा स्वराक्षरव्यञ्जनहेतुयुक्तया। वरं वृणीष्वेह विनास्य जीवितं ददानि ते सर्वमनिन्दिते वरम्॥
en: Yama said: Do go back. I have been delighted with your words couched in (proper) letters and accents and resting on reason. Do you ask for a boon with the exception of your husband's life. O lady of faultless proportions, I will give any boon (you desire).

sa: तपश्चचार या घोरं काशिकन्या पुरा सती। भीष्मस्य वधमिच्छन्ती प्रेत्यापि भरतर्षभ॥ पाञ्चालस्य सुता जज्ञे दैवाच्च स पुनः पुमान्। स्त्रीपुंसोः पुरुषव्याघ्र यः स वेद गुणागुणान्॥
en: The chaste woman, the daughter of the king of Kashi, who practiced austere asceticism, who was desirous of the destruction of Bhishma even after death (i.e. in another birth) O bull of the race of Bharata, was born as the daughter of the king of Panchala and by the hand of the gods she became a male afterwards; that one, O tiger among men, who knows the virtues and vices of female-males.

sa: उपागम्याब्रुवन् सर्वे दिष्ट्या वर्धसि शत्रुहन्। हतश्च नहुषः पापो दिष्ट्यागस्त्येन धीमता। दिष्ट्या पापसमाचारः कृतः सर्पो महीतले॥
en: They all coming there said-it is fortunate, Oslayer of enemies, that you are on the ascendant; it is fortunate that the vicious Nahusha has been killed by the wise Agastya; it is fortunate that being of vicious habits has been turned into a snake in the earth.

sa: कलहंसगणैर्जुष्टामृषिकिन्नरसेविताम् धातुभिश्च सरिदिश्च किन्नरैर्मृगपक्षिभिः॥ गन्धर्वैप्सरोभिश्च काननैश्च मनोरमैः। व्यालैश्च विविधाकारैः शतशीषैः समन्ततः॥ उपेतं पश्य कौन्तेय शैलराजमरिन्दम।
en: Adorned with swans and worshipped by the sages and the Kinnaras. O tormentor of foes, O son of Kunti, behold this prince of mountains containing minerals and rivulets, Kinnaras, deer and birds, Gandharvas and Apsaras and pleasant gardens and snakes of many shapes and of hundred heads.

sa: ऋषयो देवताश्चैव पूजयन्ति नरोत्तम। ततः कामगमॉल्लोकानपश्यं वै सुरर्षिणाम्॥ गन्धर्वाप्सरसां चैव प्रभावममितौजसाम्। नन्दनादीनि देवानां वनान्युपवनानि च॥ दर्शयामास मे शीघ्रं मातलिः शक्रसारथिः। ततः शक्रस्य भवनमपश्यममरावतीम्॥
en: (And) O the best of mortals, the sages and the gods began to pay their adorations to it. Then I beheld the regions moving at will and the splendour of the highly energetic divine sages, of the Gandharvas and of the Apsaras. (And) the charioteer of Indra, Matali, soon showed to me the garden of Nandana and other gardens and bowers of the celestials. Then I beheld the palace of Indra, Amravati,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अनुभूय तु राज्ञस्तं राजसूयं महाक्रतुम्। युधिष्ठिरस्य नृपतेर्गान्धारीपुत्रसंयुतः॥ प्रियकृन्मतमाज्ञाय पूर्वं दुर्योधनस्य तत्। प्रज्ञाचक्षुषमासीनं शकुनिः सौबलस्तदा।॥ दुर्योधनवचः श्रुत्वा धृतराष्ट्रं जनाधिपम्। उपगम्य महाप्राज्ञं शकुनिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said O king, having been impressed with the great Rajasuya sacrifice of king Yudhishthira and having also learnt the intentions of Duryodhana, from what he said, and also in order to do what was pleasing to him (Duryodhana), the son of Subala, Shakuni, accompanied by Gandhari's son (Duryodhana) to the king Dhritarashtra whose knowledge was his eye, seated (on this throne). Approaching that greatly intelligent (king), Shakuni thus spoke to him.

sa: तान् प्रस्थितानभ्यगच्छद् वृषपर्वा महीपतिः। उपन्यस्य महातेजा विप्रेभ्यः पाण्डवांस्तदा॥ अनुसंसार्य कौन्तेयानाशीर्भिरभिनन्द्य च। वृषपर्वा निववृते पन्थानमुपदिश्य च॥
en: The high-souled Vrishaparva accompanied them to a certain distance. And then committing those Pandavas of indomitable spirit of the care of the Brahma's and instructing and blessing those sons of Kunti, Vrishaparva retraced his steps after giving them directions as to the path they were to follow.

sa: त्रिशूलखातं तत्रैव तीर्थमासाद्य भारत॥ तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वीत पितृदेवार्चने रतः। गाणपत्यं च लभते देहं त्यक्त्वा न संशयः॥
en: One going there, O king, becomes adored in the celestials region. O descendant of Bharata, going there to the Tirtha called Trishulakhata and bathing there and worshipping the Pitris and the celestials, there is no doubt one obtains the state of Ganapatya after giving up his body.

sa: इन्द्रस्य वाजिनो वाहा हस्तिनोऽथ रथास्तथा॥ इच्छाम्यहमथापूर्वं वाहनं ते सुराधिप। यन्न विष्णोर्न रुद्रस्य नासुराणां न रक्षसाम्॥
en: Indra had for his conveyance, horses, elephants and a car. I wish that you, O lord of the gods should have a conveyance, the like of which was never seen before, which was never owned by Vishnu, nor by Rudra, nor by the Asuras and the Rakshasas.

sa: सदाहमार्यान्निभृतोऽप्युपासे न मे विधित्सोत्सहते न रोषः। न वाप्यहं लिप्समानः परैमि न चैव किंचिद् विषयेण यामि॥
en: Though all my objects have been fulfilled, yet I always wait respectfully on the righteous. I have no thirst. My anger has been suppressed. Seduced by covetousness I do not deviate from the path of virtue. I do not also approach any one with prayers for riches.

sa: एको वह्निः सुमना ब्राह्मणोऽत्र पञ्चेन्द्रियाणि समिधश्चात्र सन्ति। तेभ्यो मोक्षाः सप्त फलन्ति दीक्षा गुणाः फलान्यतिथयः फलाशाः॥
en: There is one fire here, possessed of a good mind. That is connected with Brahmana. The five senses are the fuel here. The seven forms of Libcration originating from them are the seven forms of Initiation. The qualities are the fruits, and the guests eat those fruits.

sa: तेषां प्रववृते युद्धं सुमहल्लोमहर्षणम्। इरावांस्तु सुसंक्रुद्धो भ्रातरौ देवरूपिणौ॥ विव्याध निशितैस्तूर्णं शरैःसंनतपर्वभिः। तावेनं प्रत्यविध्येतां समरे चित्रयोधिनौ॥
en: Then the combat that was fought between them was dreadful and horripilating. thereupon Iravat waxing wrath, quickly pierced those two brothers of godly presence, with straight knotted shafts of exceeding sharpness. those two warriors versed in diverse odes of warfare pierced Iravat in return, in that battle,

sa: प्रसक्ताश्रुमुखी त्वेवं ब्रुवती जनकात्मजा। अधोगतमुखी बाला विलप्तुमुपचक्रमे॥ उन्मत्तेव प्रमत्तेव भ्रान्तचित्तेव शोचती। उपावृत्ता किशोरीव विचेष्टन्ती महीतले॥
en: Saying this, the daughter of the king Janaka, bathed her countenance with tears and hanging down her head began to lament. And she began to roll on the earth like to a colt as if she was mad, possessed by a devil and had lost her sense.

sa: एकेन सह संगम्य रामेण रणमूर्धनि। अह्रश्चतुर्थभागेन निःशेषा राक्षसाः कृताः॥ महाबला महावीर्यास्तपसो विघ्नकारिणः। निहता राघवेणाजौ दण्डकारण्यवासिनः॥
en: In the company of one person only and at the commencement of the fight, by Rāma, within the one fourth part of a day, were exterminated all the highly powerful and valiant inhabitants of the forest of Dandaka always putting obstructions in the way of the ascetics.

sa: प्रसीद लङ्केश्वर राक्षसेन्द्र धर्मार्थतत्त्वं वचनं शृणुप्व। दूता न वध्याः समयेषु राजन् सर्वेषु सर्वत्र वदन्ति सन्तः॥
en: O lord of Lankā, be propitious. O Sovereign of Rākṣasas, listen to speech containing the significance of virtue and profit. O king, an envoy is not to be put to death on the occasion of his discharging his proper functions. This righteous people say everywhere to all.

sa: त्वं नित्यं सुविषण्णं मामाश्वासयसि लक्ष्मण। गतासुर्नाद्य शक्तोऽसि मामार्तमभिभाषितुम्॥
en: O Lakşmaņa, you ever comforts me when I am dispirited. But today, having lost your life, you can not speak to me, who am afflicted.

sa: दीयतामभिसत्कृत्य मनुजेन्द्राय मैथिली। निदर्शनं ते पर्याप्त जनस्थाने यदद्भुतम्॥
en: Do you make over Maithili to the king of men, paying him homage due. You have in Janasthāna profusely witnessed wonderful instances (of his prowess).

sa: सोऽयं मामनुपस्थाने व्यक्तं नैराश्यमागतः। क्रोधमोहसमाविष्टो व्यक्तं मां हन्तुमुद्यतः॥
en: And plainly in consequence of my refusal, he has given way to despair. And overcome by anger and passion, he is ready to slay me.

sa: तं समीक्ष्य महातेजा महेषु तेन संधितम्। लक्ष्मणोऽप्याददे बाणमन्यद्भीमपराक्रमः॥ कुबेरेण स्वयं स्वप्ने यद्दत्तममितात्मना। दुर्जयं दुर्विषां च सेन्ट्रैरपि सुरासुरैः॥
en: Seeing that mighty shaft set by him (on the bow-string), the highly powerful Laksmana, possessed of dreadful prowess, (in his turn) took up another arrow, bestowed by Kuvera himself of imme jurable soul in a dream, unconquerable, and incapable of being borne even by the celestials and Asuras with Indra at their head.
